sa: एवं दत्त्वार्जुने शापं स्फुरदोष्ठी श्वसन्त्यथ। पुन: प्रत्यागता क्षिप्रमुर्वशी गृहमात्मनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus cursed Arjuna, with her lips quivered and her breaths heavily drawn, Urvashi speedily returned to her own abode.

sa: सर्वस्यैकोऽपराधस्ते क्षन्तव्यः प्राणिनो भवेत्। द्वितीये सति वध्यस्तु स्वल्पेऽप्यपकृते भवेत्॥
en: The first offence of all men should be forgiven; when they commit the second, however insignificant it might be they should be punished.

sa: आदित्यो दिवि देवेषु तमो नुदति तेजसा। तथैव नृपतिर्भूमाबधर्मान्नुदते भृशम्॥
en: Like the sun among the gods in heaven who destroys darkness by his rays the king among men eradicates sin from the earth.

sa: मृगप्रेप्सुर्महारौद्रे वने चरति निर्भयः। स तत्र मनुजव्याघ्रो वने वनचरोपमः॥ पद्भ्यामभिसमापेदे भीमसेनो महाबलः। स प्रविष्टो महारण्ये नादान् नदति चाद्भुतान्॥ त्रासयन् सर्वभूतानि महासत्त्वपराक्रमः। ततो भीमस्य शब्देन भीताः सर्पा गुहाशया:॥
en: (He), desirous of bagging games, wandered about fearlessly in that awfully terrible forest. And in that forest, the exceedingly powerful Bhimasena, valiant and strong as the tiger, roamed on foot like the dweller of woods. And the highly energetic and exceedingly powerful (Bhimasena), entering into that great forest, sent forth strange yells terrifying all the creatures. Then serpents, frightened at the shouts of Bhimasena, hid themselves in the caves.

sa: प्राहिणोद् भीमसेनाय वेगेन महता नदन्। भक्त्वा शूलं गदाचेण गदायुद्धविशारदः॥
en: Hurled it with force at Bhimasena with tremendous roars; and that adept at macefighting, breaking that dart with the end of his mace.

sa: श्रुत्वा तन्महदाश्चर्यं द्विजोधौम्योऽब्रवीत् तदा। न शक्यमुत्तरं वक्तुमेवं भवतु भारत॥
en: On hearing this great wonder, the Brahmana Dhaumya said, "O descendant of Bharata, this should not be gain said. Let this be so."

sa: गुणान् पार्थस्य संस्मृत्य दुःखार्ताः परमातुराः। अकामाः संन्यवर्तन्त समागम्याथ पाण्डवान्।॥
en: Afflicted and overwhelmed with grief, they unwillingly retraced their steps after asking leave of the Pandavas and remembering the virtues of Pritha's sons.

sa: गोप्रतारं ततो गच्छेत् सरय्वास्तीर्थमुत्तमम्॥ यत्र रामो गत: स्वर्गं सभृत्यबलवाहनः। स च वीरो महाराज तस्य तीर्थस्य तेजसा॥
en: One should then go to Gopratara, the excellent Tirtha in the Sarayu. Where Rama went to heaven with all his servants, soldiers and beasts of burden. By giving up one's body, O king, he obtains the great effulgence of the Tirtha.

sa: प्राञ्जलिश्च सहामात्यैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। किमर्थमुपयाताः स्थ ब्रूत किं करवाणि वः॥
en: Joining his hands along with his ministers, he thus spoke, “What for have you come here? And what can I do for you?”

sa: ततो वानरकोटीभिः सहितोऽहं नरर्षभ। सीतां मार्गन्महाबाहो प्रयातो दक्षिणां दिशम्॥
en: O foremost of men, O mighty armed hero, I also with numerous other monkeys set out towards the south in search of Sita.

sa: अधर्मो हि कृतस्तेन येनैतदुपशिक्षितम्। अनृशंसास्तु कौन्तेयास्तत् प्रत्यक्षं ब्रवीमि वः॥
en: He who instructed Duryodhana to do this had certainly acted sinfully. I tell you, the sons of Kunti are not wicked and sinful."

sa: स तानुत्पतितान् दृष्ट्वा कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। महता शरजालेन समन्तात् पर्यवारयत्॥
en: But the son of Kunti, Dhananjaya (Arjuna), seeing them rise to the sky, surrounded them on all sides by a net of arrows.

sa: स ददर्शाश्रमे रम्ये पुष्पितदुमभूषिते। विचरन्तीं स्नुषां तस्य किन्नरीमिव भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, he saw in that charming hermitage adorned with blossoming trees the daughter-in-law of Raibhya who was like a Kinnari.

sa: तस्य तीर्थस्य रूपं वै दीप्ताद् दीप्ततरं बभौ। अप्रधृष्यतरवासीच्छात्रवाणां नरर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of men, after he had bathed there, his body blazed forth in brighter effulgence. and he became invincible to all foes,

sa: कस्तान् युधि समासीत जरामरणवान् नरः। तस्य ते शम एवास्तु पाण्डवैर्भरतर्षभ॥ कुरु मे वचनं राजन् मा मन्युवशमन्वगाः।
en: Who is there such a hero who being subject to old age and death will cope with them? O best of the Bharata race, let there be peace between you and the Pandavas. Follow my advice; surrender not yourself to danger.

sa: दुःशासनो दुर्विषहो दुर्मुखो दुर्जयस्तथा। बद्ध्वा ह्रियन्ते गन्धर्वै राजदाराश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Duhshasana, Durvisha, Durmukha and Durjaya are all being led away as prisoners bound in chains and also the ladies of the royal household.

sa: वहन्तु राक्षसा विप्रान् यथाश्रान्तान् यथाकृशान्। त्वयध्यमरसंकाश वह कृष्णां घटोत्कच॥
en: O Ghatotkacha, you are like a celestials; carry Krishna (Draupadi). In my opinion and it is quite evident, Bhima has entered (the forest).

sa: स्तमुत्पातं घोरमालक्ष्य राज्ञे। निवेदयामासतुरातवत् तदा ततो राजा वाक्यमिदं बभाषे॥
en: Seeing that fearful omen, Gandhari and the learned Vidura told everything in great affliction to the king (Dhritarashtra). Then the king thus spoke.

sa: तेजस्तवोग्रं न सहेत राजन् समेत्य साक्षादपि वज्रपाणिः। न हि व्यथं जातु करिष्यतस्तौ समेत्य देवैरपिधर्मराज॥ तवार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमपि प्रवृत्ती सुपर्णकेतुश्च शिनेश्च नप्ता। तथैव कृष्णोऽप्रतिमो बलेन तथैव चाहं नरदेववर्य॥
en: (For), O king, even the wielder of the thunderbolt himself cannot bear the burnt of your fiery prowess. And O foremost of the virtuous, he, having Suparna for his mark, Krishna and the grandson of Shini Satyaki, both bent on your welfare, will not feel any pain even when fighting the gods themselves. As Arjuna is unrivalled in prowess, so am I, O monarch.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भूय एवाहमिच्छामि महर्षेस्तस्यधीमतः। कर्मणां विस्तरं श्रोतुमगस्त्यस्य द्विजोत्तम॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O foremost of Brahmanas, I desire to hear in detail more of the achicvements of the highly intelligent great Rishi Agastya.

sa: निरुष्य तत्र सुचिरमेवं वह्रिर्वशं गतः। मनस्तासु विनिक्षिप्य कामयानो वराङ्गनाः॥
en: Attracted by their beauty, he lived there for a long time. Being filled with great love for them, he gave them his heart.

sa: अवाप्य वासं नरदेवपुत्राः प्रसादजं वैश्रवणस्य राज्ञः। न प्राणिनां ते स्पृहयन्ति राजन् शिवश्च कालः स बभूव तेषाम्॥
en: O monarch, those sons of a king, having obtained a residence through the favour of king Vaisravana, did not long for the prosperity of earthly creatures, (in as much as) that period (of their lives) was (quite) a blessing (to them).

sa: एष रौद्रश्च सङ्घातो महान् युक्तश्च तेजसा। सोमस्य वह्निसूर्याभ्यामद्भुतोऽयं समागमः॥
en: This great conjunction is terrible and it is full of effulgence. This union of the sun, moon and the fire is very wonderful.

sa: ततः पार्थो महाबाहुरवतीर्य रथोत्तमात्। ददर्श साक्षाद् देवेशं पितरं पाकशासनम्॥
en: Thereupon descending from the excellent car, the mighty-armed son of Pritha, saw his father, the king of gods and the chastiser of Paka.

sa: गन्धर्वास्त्रासितान् दृष्ट्वा चित्रसेनो ह्यमर्षणः॥ उत्पपातासनात् क्रुद्धो वधे तेषां समाहितः।
en: Seeing the Gandharva army afflicted with fear, Chitrasena jumped up in great anger from his seat and resolved to exterminate the Kuru army.

sa: तस्मात् प्राज्ञैश्च वृद्धैश्च सुस्वभावैस्तपस्विभिः। सद्भिश्च सह संसर्गः कार्यः शमपरायणैः॥
en: Therefore those who are virtuously inclined should associate with men who are wise, old, honest and pure in conduct and who are ascetics.

sa: न तास्तं शक्नुवन्ति स्म व्याहर्तुमपि किंचन। तेजसाधर्षितास्तस्य लज्जावत्यो वराङ्गनाः॥
en: Those most excellent women, over-powered by his splendour and out of bashfulness, were not at all able to go near or address him.

sa: तान् स सर्वान् समागम्य विधिवत् कुरुनन्दनः। ततोऽपश्यद् देवराजं शतक्रतुमरिंदम्॥
en: Having duly saluted them all, that descendant of Kuru, the slayer of enemies, beheld the king of celestials, the performer of hundred sacrifices.

sa: ते यात्वा पाण्डवास्तत्र ब्राह्मणैर्बहुभिः सह। पुण्यं द्वैतवनं रम्यं विविशुर्भरतर्षभाः॥
en: And setting out with these numberless Brahmanas the Bharata chiefs, the sons of Pandu, entered the holy and the charming forest of Dvyaita.

sa: विप्रियं ह्याचरन् मयों देवानां मृत्युमृच्छति। त्राहि मामनवद्याङ्गि वरयस्व सुरोत्तमान्॥
en: By offending the celestials, the mortals receive death. Therefore, O beauteous lady, save me by choosing one of the gods for your lord.

sa: उपस्थाने महेन्द्रस्य वर्तमाने मनोरमे। तवागमनतो वृत्ते स्वर्गस्य परमोत्सवे॥ रुद्राणां चैव सांनिध्यमादित्यानां च सर्वशः। समागमेऽश्विनोश्चैव वसूनां च नरोत्तम॥ महर्षीणां च संघेषु राजर्षिप्रवरेषु च। सिद्धचारणयक्षेषु महोरगगणेषु च॥ उपविष्टेषु सर्वेषु स्थानमानप्रभावतः। ऋद्ध्या प्रज्वलमानेषु अग्निसोमार्कवर्मसु॥ वीणासु वाद्यमानासु गन्धर्वैः शक्रनन्दन। दिव्ये मनोरमे गेये प्रवृत्ते पृथुलोचन॥ सर्वाप्सरःसु मुख्यासु प्रनृत्तासु कुरूद्वह। त्वं किलानिमिषः पार्थ मामेकां तत्र दृष्टवान्।॥
en: On account of your coming here, Mahendra had convened a large and charming assembly in which great festivities of heaven were held. O best of men, there came all the Rudras, the Adityas. A large member of great Rishis, also royal sages, the Siddhas, the Charanas, the Yakshas and the great Nagas. When all those (celestials) as effulgent as the fire or the sun or the moon took their seats according to their rank, honour and prowess. The Gandharvas, O son of Shakra (Indra), O large-eyed hero, began to play on the Vinas and to sing the charming songs of celestials melody. O perpetuator of the Kuru race, the chief Apsaras also began to dance. O Partha, you had looked at me only once with a steadfast gaze.

sa: उदीची दीपयन्नेष दिशं तिष्ठति वीर्यवान्। महामेरुर्महाभाग शिवो ब्रह्मविदां गतिः॥
en: O highly fortunate one, illuminating the northern point, there stretches the powerful and auspicious (Mountains) Mahameru-the refuge to those holding communion with Brahma.

sa: चित्रसेन उवाच विदितोऽयमभिप्रायस्तत्रस्थेन दुरात्मनः। दुर्योधनस्य पापस्य कर्णस्य च धनंजय॥
en: Chitrasena said : O Dhananjaya, I knew long before the (real) purpose of the wicked Duryodhana and the wretched Karna in coming here.

sa: सोमधेयांश्च निर्जित्य प्रययावुत्तरामुखः। वत्सभूमिं च कौन्तेयो विजिग्ये बलवान् बलात्॥
en: And the Somadheyas. He then marched towards the north. The mighty son of Kunti (Bhima) then by force conquered the country, named Vatsabhumi.

sa: ततः सुदीर्घ गत्वाहं प्लवमानो नराधिप। श्रान्तः क्वचिन शरणं लभाम्यहमतन्द्रितः॥
en: O ruler of men, then thus roving about for a long time, I became fatigued; but I did not get any resting place.

sa: एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच भगवान् मुनिपुङ्गवः। जीर्णं तद्धि मया तोयमुपायोऽन्यः प्रचिन्त्यताम्॥ पूरणार्थं समुद्रस्य भवद्भिर्यत्नमास्थितैः। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं महर्षे वितात्मनः॥ विस्मिताश्च विषण्णाश्च बभूवुः सहिताः सुराः। परस्परमनुज्ञाप्य प्रणम्य मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the exalted great Rishi thus replied. “The water has been digested by me. Think of other means, if you are willing to fill up the ocean with water." Having heard those words of that high-souled grcat Rishi, the assembled celestials, were all filled with wonder and also with sorrow, Bidding farewell to one another and bowing to the great Rishi.

sa: भ्रातुर्येष्ठस्य वचनं पाण्डवाः संनिशम्य तत्। तमेव समवर्तन्त धर्मराजहिते रताः॥
en: Having heard these words of their elder brother, the Pandavas, ever engaged in doing what is agreeable to Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), approved of them.

sa: ते सर्वेधृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रेण परिसान्त्विताः। संविभक्ताश्च तुष्टाश्च गुरुवत् तेषु वर्तते॥
en: They are all conciliated honoured and gratified by the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana) who behaves to them as one does towards his preceptor.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु विप्रेन्द्रोधर्मराज्ञा महात्मना। कथयामास माहात्म्यं सगरस्य महात्मनाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by the highsouled Dharmaraja, Yudhishthira, that foremost of Brahmanas narrated the glory of the illustrious Sagara.

sa: कल्माषीतीरसंस्थस्य गतस्त्वं शिष्यतां भृगोः। द्रष्टा सदा नारदस्ते धौम्यस्तेऽयं पुरोहितः॥
en: You became a disciple of Bhrigu on the banks of the Kalmashi. Narada and your this priest Dhaumya will be now your instructors.

sa: ततो मामब्रवीद् बालः स पद्यनिभलोचनः। श्रीवत्सधारी द्युतिमान् वाक्यं श्रुतिसुखावहम्॥
en: That lotus-eyed and greatly effulgent boy with the mark of Srivatsa then thus spoke to me in words highly pleasant to the ear.

sa: राजा ययातिौहित्रैः पतितस्तारितो यथा। सद्भिः पुरुषशार्दूल तथाहं भवता द्विजः॥
en: O foremost of men, as the fallen king Yayati was saved by his virtuous grandson, so have I now been saved by you.

sa: ततोऽहं समवस्थाप्य रथं सौभसमीपतः। शङ्ख प्रध्माप्य हर्षेण सुहृदः पर्यहर्षयम्॥
en: Thereupon taking my chariot in front of the city of Saubha, I cheerfully blew my conch and gladdened the hearts of my friends.

sa: कामिनः सह कान्ताभिः परस्परमनुव्रताः। दृश्यन्ते शैलशृङ्गस्था यथा किम्पुरुषा नृप॥
en: O King, amorous persons with their sweet hearts mutually enamoured of one another and Kimpurushas are seen on the summits of this mountain.

sa: वेदोच्चारणकार्यार्थमयुक्तं तत् त्वया कृतम्। तव शोकेन वृद्धौ तावन्धीभूतौ तपस्विनौ॥
en: You have not properly acted in this matter, for your ascetic and aged parents have become completely blind from grief at your loss.

sa: प्रच्छन्ना हि महात्मानश्चरन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम्। दैवेन विधिना युक्ताः शास्त्रोक्तैश्च निरूपणैः॥
en: Sometimes, indeed, great men rove over this world in disguise either ordained by mishap or in obedience to the dictates of the Shastras.

sa: ननु नाम महाराजधर्मज्ञः सत्यवागसि। कथमुक्त्वा तथा सत्यं सुप्तामुत्सृज्य कानने॥
en: O mighty monarch! you are virtuous and truthful. How then, promising not to do so you have forsaken me asleep, in the woods?

sa: तत् समासाद्य नगरं सौभं व्यपगतत्विषम्। मध्येन पाटयामास क्रकचो दार्विवोच्छ्रितम्॥
en: Approaching the city of Saubha, the splendour of which had disappeared, it went right through it as a saw divides a tall tree.

sa: गव्यूतिमात्रे न्यवसद् राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। प्रयातो वाहनैः सर्वैस्ततो द्वैतवनं सरः॥
en: Arriving at the lake of Dvaitavana with his followers and conveyances, king Duryodhana encamped at the distance of four miles from the lake.

sa: द्रोणस्तव महेष्वासः सह पुत्रेण वीर्यवान्। सूतपुत्रश्च राधेयो गौतमश्च महारथः॥
en: The wielder of the great bow the greatly powerful Drona with his son, the Suta's son, Radheya (Karna), the great car-warrior, Goutama (Kripa),

sa: संधौ संधौ संनिविष्टः सर्वेष्वपि तथानिलः। शरीरेषु मनुष्याणां व्यान इत्युपदिश्यते॥
en: When it manifests itself by its presence at all the junction points of the system, it is known by the name of Vyana.

sa: आस्थास्यति पुनर्भमी दमयन्ती स्वयंवरम्। तत्र गच्छन्ति राजानो राजपुत्राश्च सर्वशः॥
en: 'Damayanti, the daughter of king Bhima, will again hold the Svayamvara, to which all the kings and princes are rushing from all directions.

sa: गते तु तस्मिन् नरदेववर्यः शक्रात्मजः शक्ररिपुप्रमाथी। शक्रेण दत्तानि ददौ महात्मा महाधनान्युत्तमरूपवन्ति॥ दिवाकराभाणि विभूषणानि प्रियः प्रियायै सुतसोममात्रे। ततः स तेषां कुरुपुङ्गवानां तेषां च सूर्याग्निसमप्रभाणाम्॥ विप्रर्षभाणामुपविश्य मध्ये सर्वं यथावत् कथयांबभूवा एवं मयास्त्राण्युपशिक्षितानि शक्राच्च वाताच्च शिवाच्च साक्षात्॥
en: He (Matali) having departed; that foremost of the royal race-the slayer of all the foes-the noble-minded son of Sakra, made over to his sweet-heart-the mother of Sutashoma-those beautiful and precious gems and ornaments of sun-like splendour presented by Sakra. Then sitting amidst those best of the Kurus and those Brahmanas having the lustre of the sun or fire, he (Arjuna), narrated (to them) faithfully all that happened (to him in heaven). "In this way, I have learnt the (science of) arms from Sakra, Vayu and Shiva himself;

sa: अर्चयित्वा पितृन् देवानश्वमेधफलं लभेत्। ईशानाध्युषितं नाम तत्र तीर्थं सुदुर्लभम्॥
en: And worshipping the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice. There is a a very inaccessible Tirtha, called Ishanadhyushita.

sa: तस्य गात्राणि सर्वाणि चूर्णयामास पाण्डवः। अरनिना चाभिहत्य शिरः कायादपाहरत्॥ संदष्टौष्ठं विवृत्ताक्षं फलं वृक्षादिव च्युतम्। जटासुरस्य तु शिरो भीमसेनबलाद्धतम्॥
en: That son of Pandu pounded (into atoms) all his limbs; and striking him with his elbow, he severed from his body the head with bitten lips and rolling eyes like a fruit from its stem. The head of Jatasura, being severed by the strength of Bhimasena.

sa: विशीर्णमलिनोष्णीषः प्रकीर्णाम्बरमूर्धजः। प्रपतन् दृश्यते ह स्म क्षीणपुण्य इव ग्रहः॥
en: I saw my father falling like a luminary whose merit is lost, his headgear pale and loosely flowing his hair and dress disordered.

sa: सुयोधनो नाहतीति क्षमामेवं न विन्दति। अर्हस्तत्राहमित्येवं तस्मान्मां विन्दते क्षमा॥
en: Suyodhana does not deserve kingdom and therefore he does not know forgiveness; I deserve it and therefore forgiveness has taken possession of me.

sa: तस्य रूपं प्रपततः पितुर्मम नराधिप। ययातेः क्षीणपुण्यस्य स्वर्गादिव महीतलम्॥
en: O ruler of men, my father appeared like Yayati when he (that king) losing all his virtues fell down towards earth from heaven.

sa: ततः संकीर्त्यमानेषु राज्ञां नामसु भारत। ददर्श भैमी पुरुषान् पञ्चतुल्याकृतीनिह॥
en: Thereupon, ( Bharata, the names of the kings having been ultered, the daughter of Bhima beheld five persons all alike in their form.

sa: उग्रं तप: समास्थाय दिवाकरमथाश्रितः। रहस्यवेदं कृतवान् सूर्यस्य द्विजसत्तमः॥ मूर्तिमांस्तं ददर्शाथ स्वयमग्रभुगव्ययः। लोमश उवाच प्रीतास्तस्याभवन् देवाः कर्मणार्वावसोनूप॥
en: Performing severe austerities, he took protection in the sun. Thereupon the mystery of the sun revealed in him and that eternal deity appeared before him in an embodied form. O king, the celestials were exceedingly pleased with that act of Arvavasu.

sa: तमार्तनादं सहसा शुश्राव स महीपतिः। अमात्यपर्षदो मध्ये उपविष्टः सहर्विजा॥
en: When he was seated with his ministers and his family priest that ruler of earth suddenly heard that great screaming (of the women).

sa: अथवा सायुधा वीरा मन्युनाभिपरिप्लुताः। सहिता बद्धनिस्त्रिंशा दहेयुः शस्त्रतेजसा॥ वै
en: Or perhaps, those heroes, armed with swords and other weapons and filled with wrath, may consume you with the fire of their weapons.

sa: समृद्धैश्च न नन्दन्ति बान्धवा बान्धवैरपि। गुरूंश्चैव विनिन्दन्ति मूढाः पण्डितमानिनः॥
en: Friends are not agreeable to friends, however accomplished they might be. Foolish pedantic men (ever) find fault with the virtue of their preceptors.

sa: कथं प्रवर्षेत् पर्जन्य उपायः परिदृश्यताम्। तमूचुश्चोदितास्ते तु स्वमतानि मनीषिणः॥
en: (He said), “How can the clouds pour rain, find out a means." Those intelligent men assembling together, gave out each their own opinions.

sa: मयैष प्रार्थितः पूर्वमिन्द्रकीलसमप्रभः। अनादृत्य च तद् वाक्यं प्रजहाराथ फाल्गुनः॥
en: (He said), “This boar like the Indrakila in colour has been first aimed by me." But disregarding his word, Falguni (Arjuna) struck it.

sa: दमयन्त्या तथोक्ता सा देवी भृशदुःखिता। बाष्पेणापिहिता राज्ञी नोत्तरं किंचिदब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus addressed by Damayanti,"the goddesslike queen became greatly afflicted with grief and was suffused with tears and spoke nothing to her in reply.

sa: धान्यबीजानि यान्याहुज्ह्यादीनि द्विजोत्तम। सर्वाण्येतानि जीवानि तत्र किं प्रतिभाति ते॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, Vrihi and other so called seeds of rice are all living organisms, what is your opinion on this matter?

sa: बलदेवो महाबाहुः कच्चिज्जीवति शत्रुहा। सात्यकी रौक्मिण्येश्च चारुदेष्णश्च वीर्यवान्॥ साम्बप्रभृतयश्चैवेत्यहमासं सुदुर्मनाः। एतेषु हि नरव्याघ्र जीवत्सु न कथंचन॥ शक्यः शूरसुतो हन्तुमपि वज्रभृता स्वयम्। हतः शूरसुतो व्यक्तं चैते परासवः॥ बलदेवमुखाः सर्व इति मे निश्चिता मतिः। सोऽहं सर्वविनाशं तं चिन्तयानो मुहुर्मुहुः। अविह्वलो महाराज पुनः शाल्वमयोधयम्॥
en: I asked myself in sorrow, “Do that slayer of foes Baladeva, Satyaki, the son of Rukmani, (Pradyumna) the greatly powerful Charudeshna, Samba and others live? O best of men, if they were alive. Even the wielder of thunder (Indra) could not have killed the son of Sura (my father). It is evident the son of Sura is dead; it is also evident that the others. With Baladeva at their head have all lost their lives. This is my firm belief.” I was again and again filled with the thought of their destruction. I was overwhelmed with grief, great king, but I again fought with Shalva.

sa: अथापराह्ने तस्याह्नः प्रावात् पुण्यः समीरणः। पुनर्नवमिमं लोकं कुर्वन्निव सपत्नहन्।॥
en: Then, O destroyer of foes, in the afternoon of that day, it pure brceze began to blow, as if making this world anew.

sa: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ दीर्घसत्रं यथाक्रमम्। तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः॥
en: O king, one should then go in due order to Dirghasatra. There did Brahma and the celestials, the Siddhas and the great Rishis.

sa: सर्वारम्भाः सुप्रवृत्ता गोरक्षा कर्षणं वणिक्। विशेषात् सर्वमेवैतत् संजज्ञे राजकर्मणः॥
en: As the result of the king's (virtuous) acts every thing of the kingdom, specially the breeding of cattle, agriculture and trade, greatly flourished.

sa: द्वारकाधिपतिर्वीर आह त्वामाहुको वचः। केशवैहि विजानीष्व यत् त्वां पितृसखोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: (He said), "O hero, the king of Dvarka, Ahuka, has said this to you. “O Keshava, hear what your father's friend has said.

sa: ब्राह्मणं उवाच प्रीतोऽस्मि तव भद्रं ते गतः क्रोधश्च शोभने। उपालम्भस्त्वयात्युक्तो मम निःश्रेयसं परम्। स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि साधयिष्यामि शोभने।॥
en: The Brahmana said: O beauteous lady, be happy. I am much satisfied with you. My wrath has been appeased. The chiding's uttered by you will prove most beneficial to me. O beautiful one, be happy. I shall go there and perform what is advantageous to me.

sa: सोऽयमभ्यागतो मूढो ममेदं गहनं वनम्। प्रचारसमयेऽस्माकमर्धरात्रे स्थिते स मे॥
en: That fool has now come to my this deep forest. At a time when the night is half-spent and when we wander about.

sa: यवक्रीतस्य यत् तीर्थमुचितं शौचकर्मणि। भागीरथ्यां तत्र सेतुं बालुकाभिश्चकार स:॥
en: He began to construct a dam of sands at thai spot of the Bhagirathi where Yavakrit used to go to perform his ablutions.

sa: मद्गतानि च जानीहि सर्वास्त्राणि कुरूद्वह। एवमुक्त्वा तु मां शक्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: And, Operpetuator of the Kuru race, all those weapons are presided over by me." Addressing me thus, Sakra vanished at that very spot.

sa: अथापश्यं हरियुतं रथमैन्द्रमुपस्थितम्। दिव्यं मायामयं पुण्यं यत्तं मातलिना नृप।॥
en: Then, O king, I saw that sacred, celestials and wonderful and car of Indra, yoked with horses and driven by Matali arrive (there).

sa: कस्य कर्मेदमिति ते पर्यपृच्छन् समागताः। युवनाश्वो ममेत्येवं सत्यं समभिपद्यत॥
en: The assembled all together and asked one another who had done this. Then Yuvanashva told the truth saying, “It was done by me.”

sa: स्थापयित्वा च मर्यादाः स्वयम्भुविहिताः शुभाः। वनं पुण्ययश:कर्मा रमणीयं प्रवेक्ष्यति॥
en: Having established the blessed rectitude ordained by the Self-create (Brahma), that doer of virtuous and renowned deeds will then enter a charming forest.

sa: इत्युक्तास्ते ययुर्हष्टा ब्राह्मणाः सर्वतो दिशम्॥ पुरराष्ट्राणि चिन्वन्तो नैषधं सह भार्यया। नैव क्वापि प्रपश्यन्ति नलं वा भीमपुत्रिकाम्॥ ततश्चेदिपुरी रम्यां सुदेवो नाम वै द्विजः। विचिन्वानोऽथ वैदर्भीमपश्यद् राजवेश्मनि॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the Brahmanasa went out in all directions, searching for Nala and Damayanti in the various cities and provinces. But they could not see Nala or the daughter of Bhima anywhere. While at last a Brahmana, Sudeva by name, was searching in the city of the king of the Chedis, he saw the daughter of the king of the Vidarbhas, Damayanti.

sa: एष चैव महेष्वासस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः। अहं चापि नरश्रेष्ठादर्जुनान्नावरः क्वचित्॥
en: This powerful bowman is known all over the three worlds and I am by no means inferior to Arjuna, that best of men.

sa: कच्चिद् वृत्ति वर्तते वै पुराणी कच्चिद् भोगान् धार्तराष्ट्रो ददाति। अङ्गहीनान् कृपणान् वामनान् वा यानानृशंस्यो धृतराष्ट्रो बिभति॥ अन्धांश्च सर्वान् स्थविरांस्तथैव हस्त्याजीवा बहवो येऽत्र सन्ति। ऽप्यनामयं परिपृच्छेर्जघन्यम्॥
en: Does the son of Dhritarashtra continue the stipend granted you in old and does he allow you comforts. Those persons of defective limbs, idiots and dwarfs whom the humane Dhritarashtra supports and the many blind persons and decrepit ones and those who live by their hands (having no legs) that are there should be first told of my welfare and then asked about theirs.

sa: स यद् ब्रूयान्महाबाहुस्तत कार्यमविशङ्कया। वासुदेवेन तीर्थेन क्षिप्रं संशाम्य पाण्डवैः॥
en: What that being with long arms says, should be done without hesitation. Effect peace quickly with the Pandavas through the instrumentality of Vasudeva.

sa: उत्थाय सत्यवांश्चापि प्रमृज्याङ्गानि पाणिना। सर्वा दिशः समालोक्य कठिने दृष्टिमादधे॥
en: Satyavana too having risen, rubbed his limbs with his hand. Then looking around all sides, he cast his eyes on the fruit bag.

sa: अर्जुनेनार्जुनो यः स कृष्ण बाहुसहस्रिणा। द्विबाहुः स्पर्धते नित्यमतीतेनापि केशव॥ क्षिपत्येकेन वेगेन पञ्च बाणशतानि यः। इष्वस्त्रे सदृशो राज्ञः कार्तवीर्यस्य पाण्डवः॥ तेजसाऽऽदित्यसदृशो महर्षिसदृशो दमे। क्षमया पृथिवीतुल्यो महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः॥ आधिराज्यं महद् दीप्तं प्रथितं मधुसूदन। आहृतं येन वीर्येण कुरूणां सर्वराजसु॥ यस्य बाहुबलं सर्वे पाण्डवाः पर्युपासते। स सर्वरथिनां श्रेष्ठः पाण्डवः सत्यविक्रमः॥ यं गत्वाऽभिमुखः संख्ये न जीवन् कश्चिदाव्रजेत्। यो जेता सर्वभूतानामजेयो जिष्णुरच्युत।॥ योऽपाश्रयः पाण्ड
en: That two armed Arjuna, O Krishna, who is ever proud of being superior to that Arjuna of ancient days, who had a thousand arms, who with one of his arms darts with violence five hundred arrows, that son of Pandu, who in the use of arrows is equal to the royal son of Kartavirya, equal in energy to Aditya, in selfcontrol equal to a great Rishi, in forbearance equal to the Earth and in prowess equal to the great Indra, that strength by which all kings, the descendants of Kuru, have acquired this large territory of great effulgence; whose strength of arms all the sons of Pandu respect, that son of Pandu, foremost among all the carwarriors, of true prowess; going to whose front no one returns with his life, he, O Achyuta, who is accustomed to victories over all creatures and himself being invinc

sa: स वध्यमानो गृध्रेण रामप्रियहितैषिणा। खङ्गमादाय चिच्छेद भुजौ तस्य पतत्रिणः॥
en: Thus struck by the vulture, the well-wisher of Rama, he (Ravana) taking up his sword cut off the wings of that feathery creature.

sa: निर्वादादास्पदं लब्वा धनवृद्धिर्भवष्यति। धनवन्तं हि मित्राणि भजन्ते चाश्रयन्ति च॥
en: Attaining to prosperity by these friendly means, there occurs an increase in wealth. Friends seeks the refuge of the wealthy and worship him.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्य सव्यसाची परंतपः। यदुक्तं वासुदेवेन श्रावयामास तद् वचः॥
en: Savyasachin that chastiser of foes, hearing these words of the virtuous king, repeated before him the words said by Vasudeva (in this connection).

sa: विस्फारस्तस्य धनुषो यन्त्रस्येव तदा बभौ। वितत्रास तदा वाली शरेणाभिहतोरसि॥
en: The twang of his bow was like (the roar of) an engine. And pierced through the heart by the arrow Bali became alarmed.

sa: रामस्तु चतुरो मासान् पृष्ठे माल्यवत: शुभे। निवासमकरोद् धीमान् सुग्रीवेणाभ्युपस्थितः॥
en: And the intelligent Rama too, worshipped by Sugriva, in every way, lived on the auspicious plateau of the mountain Malyavan for four months.

sa: विविधास्तरणास्तीर्णमभ्युपाविशदच्युतः। तस्मिन् गां मधुपर्कं चाप्युदकं च जनार्दने॥ निवेदयामास तदा गृहान् राज्यं च कौरवः। तत्र गोविन्दमासीनं प्रसन्नादित्यवर्चसम्॥
en: And ornamented with diverse gems and overlaid with a carpet. The Kuru king then presented a cow, honey, curds and water and placed at his disposal his palaces in the kingdom; and then to Govinda seated here like the radiant Sun.

sa: स्पर्धते सर्वदेवैर्यः कालोपहतचेतनः। मया विनाशलिङ्गानि स्वप्ने दृष्टानि तस्य वै॥
en: He challenges all the gods having lost his sense through Fate. I have in my dream seen all the indications of his destruction.

sa: अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठः पर्यवर्तत भारत॥ प्रावर्तयन्नदी घोरां शोणितोदां तरङ्गिणीम्।
en: Arjuna, the foremost of victors, ranged in the battle-field. He made a river of mighty currents having blood for the water to flow,

sa: लब्धवान् युध्यमानौ द्वौ बृहन्तौ गजकच्छपौ। अत्र चक्रधनुर्नाम सूर्याज्जातो महानृषिः॥
en: See fighting with each other, a large elephant and a big tortoise. Here was born from the sun the great Rishi named Chakradhanu,

sa: परावृत्तो धनुर्गृह्य सुशर्मा भ्रातृभिः सह। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण भीमसेनेन ते रथाः॥
en: Taking up his bow, Susharma with his brothers turned back and within the twinkling of an eye those cars (were destroyed by) Bhimasena.

sa: तस्मै प्रयतमानाय सारथ्यर्थं बृहन्नले। आचचक्षे हयज्ञाने सैरन्ध्री कौशलं तव॥
en: O Brihannala, while he was trying to find out a charioteer, Sairandhri spoke to him about your skill in the management of horses.

sa: सत्यं वदत्यस्य पिता सत्यं माता प्रभाषते। तथास्य ब्राह्मणाश्चक्रुर्नामैतत् सत्यवानिति॥
en: It is because his father is (ever) truthful and his mother speaks the truth, that the Brahmanas have named him Satyavana (i.e. truthful).

sa: य ईर्षुः परवित्तेषु रूपे वीर्ये कुलान्वये। सुखसौभाग्यसत्कारे तस्य व्याधिरनन्तकः॥
en: He who is envious of other people's wealth, beauty, prowess, good birth, happiness, luck and reward, suffers a disease which has no cure.

sa: तमासनगतं वीरं सुहृदां हर्षवर्धनम्। उपासाञ्चक्रिरे सर्वे सह पाथैः परंतपाः॥
en: All the heroes, with the sons of Pritha, worshipped the heroic (Virata) the increaser of friend's joy, who was seated on his throne.

sa: सावित्र्या ग्लायमानायास्तिष्ठन्त्यास्तु दिवानिशम्। नारदेन यदुक्तं तद् वाक्यं मनसि वर्तते॥
en: And Savitri too, whether asleep or awake, could not forget the words of Narada which were present in her mind day and night.

sa: केकया धृष्टकेतुश्च पुत्रः काश्यस्य चाभिभुः। श्रेणिमान् वसुदानश्च शिखण्डी चापराजितः॥
en: The Kaikeya princes and Dhrishtaketu the son of the prince of the Kashis, Shrenimat, Vasudana, and Shikhandin who had never met with defeat,

sa: सुपर्णोऽथाब्रवीद् दीनं गालवं भृशदुःखितम्। प्रत्यक्षं खल्विदानी मे विश्वामित्रो यदुक्तवान्।॥
en: Suparna then said to Galava who was struck with great sorrow, "What Vishvamitra said to you before, he has repeated in my presence.

sa: तस्य तानस्यतो घोरानिषून परतनुच्छिदः :॥ कदर्थीकृत्य स मुनिरिषीकाभिः समार्पयत्।
en: The Rishi, by means of the same blades of grass, neutralized the terrible arrows capable of rending asunder the body of the enemies.

sa: ततः किरातास्तद् दृष्ट्वा प्रार्थयन्तो महीपते। विनेशुर्विषमे तस्मिन् ससर्प गिरिगह्वरे॥
en: Then did the hunters, seeing that strive to obtain it, О king and were destroyed in thai frightful mountain cavern full of snakes.

sa: संध्याकालं उपावृत्ते मुहुर्ते चातिदारुणे। ततः संचिन्त्य भगवान् वरदानं महात्मनः॥
en: It was evening and the moment was aweinspiring and the god thus thought of the boons granted by the large minded one (Vishnu).

sa: विराटदुपदौ चैव कृतवैरौ मया सह। तौ च सेनाप्रणेतारौ वासुदेववशानुगौ॥
en: Virata and Drupada too entertain feelings of enmity towards me; and those two leaders of armies too are under the influence of Vasudeva.

sa: स राममुद्दिश्य शरैस्ततो दत्तवरैस्तदा॥ 'विव्याध सर्वगात्रेषु लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्।
en: He (Indrajita), then, aiming at Rama and the highly-powerful Lakshmana began to pierce them, with arrows obtained as boons, all over their bodies.

sa: तत्र केशवमानचुः सम्यगभ्यागतं सभाम्। राजानः पार्थिवाः सर्वे कुरवश्च जनार्दनम्॥
en: Then all the kings and rulers of the earth and all the Kurus worshipped Keshava or Janardana who had come into the AssemblyHall..

sa: संजय उवाच धर्मनित्या पाण्डव ते विचेष्टा लोके श्रुता दृश्यते चापि पार्थ। महाश्रावं जीवितं चाप्यनित्यं सम्पश्यत्वं पाण्डव मा व्यनीनशः॥
en: Sanjaya said That you are attached to virtue, O Pandava, is known in this word and I see also that it is so, O son of Pritha. The life that is full of great deeds, also is unstable; considering this, you should not destroy (the Kurus).

sa: एकः सम्पन्नमश्नाति वस्ते वासश्च शोभनम्। योऽसंविभज्य भृत्येभ्यः को नृशंसतरस्ततः॥
en: Who is meaner then he who though possessed of riches eats and wears pretty looking dresses alone without sharing them amongst his dependents.

sa: निबन्धनी ह्यर्थतृष्णेह पार्थ तामिच्छता बाध्यते धर्म एव। धर्मं तु यः प्रवृणीते स बुद्धः कामे गृध्नो हीयतेऽर्थानुरोधात्॥
en: Thirst for wealth is a bond in this world, O son of Pritha. Those, who desire it, go against virtue as it were. He who chooses virtue is wise. The man, who desires pleasure, becomes degraded for the sake of pleasure.

sa: न तन्मित्रं यस्य कोपाद् बिभेति यद् वा मित्रं शङ्कितेनोपचर्यम्। यस्मिन् मित्रे पितरीवाश्वसीत तद् वै मित्रं सङ्गत्तानीतराणि॥
en: He whose anger inspires fear or he who must be waited upon with fear is not a friend; but the friend whom one can trust as a father is a true friend. Other kinds of friendship are merely contracted in name.

sa: एवं वदान्यो धर्मज्ञः सत्यसंधश्च सोऽभवत्। प्रियः प्रजानामपि संस्त्वग्दोषेण प्रदूषितः॥
en: Though he was benevolent, conversant with virtue, attached to truth, and loved by his subjects yet he has a defect in his skin.

sa: तालमात्रं महास्कन्धं मूर्धशुष्कं विशाम्पते।॥ तं नागवदुपक्रम्य बाहुभ्यां परिरभ्य च।
en: Tall as a palmyra, with huge branches and with red top; then holding it like an elephant with his arms, he uprooted it.

sa: तत् प्रभन्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा पार्थमाजिस्थितं पुनः। अभिप्रायं समाज्ञाय वैराटिरिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Beholding the army thus routed and with a view to decipher Partha intention the son of Virata addressed Partha in the battle-field saying:

sa: एवमेव गतिर्नूनं भवान् विषयवासिनाम्। गतिमन्तो वयं त्वद्य सर्वे विषयवासिनः॥
en: Even like him you are forsooth the refuge of those who live in this country; we all look upon you as our protector.

sa: एवमेषामनीकानि प्रविभक्तानि भागशः। यते ते कार्य सपुत्रस्य क्रियतां तदकालिकम्॥
en: In this way has this army been divided into batches. Do whatever is to be done by you, along with your son, speedily.

sa: शतं शतसहस्राणां यत्र स्थूणा हिरण्मयी। मणिरत्नमयी चान्या प्रासादं तदधारयत्॥ ततः कामगमं दिव्यं सर्वरलविभूषितम्। विमानं देवराजस्य शुशुभे खेचरं तदा॥
en: The celestial car of the king of the celestials coursing at will, crested with pearls and jewels and the roof of which was upheld by hundreds and thousands of golden pillars and the one which was made of pearls and jewels, shone in the clear sky.

sa: दिव्यानां सर्वमाल्यानां गन्धः पुण्योऽथ सर्वशः। प्रससार वसन्ताग्रे वनानामिव भारत॥
en: The holy fragrance of the celestial garlands spread all over like the odour of the blossoming trees in the beginning of the spring.

sa: रणयज्ञे प्रवितते सुभीमे लोमहर्षणे। दीक्षितं चिररात्राय श्रुत्वा तत्र युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Was employed for life as the chief priest of that sacrifice of battle, which was fierce and hair-stirring. Healing this what did Yudhishthira,

sa: ज्येष्ठाय राज्यमदाद् धृतराष्ट्राय धीमते। यवीयसे तथा क्षत्रे कुरूणां वंशवर्धनः॥
en: To his elder brother the wise Dhritarashtra, that perpetuator of the Kuru race gave the kingdom as also to his younger brother Vidura.

sa: अपि चाप्यवदद् राजन् परमेष्ठी प्रजापतिः। व्यूढे देवासुरे युद्धेऽब्युद्यतेष्वायुधेषु च॥
en: Paramesthi, the lord of all creatures said, O king, when the gods and the Asuras were prepared for battle and were under arms.

sa: यस्तताप तपो घोरं सदारः पृथिवीपतिः। रोषाद् द्रोणविनाशाय वीरः समितिशोभनः॥
en: The lord of the earth who in company with his wife practiced hard austerities for destroying Drona, that hero who adorns an assembly,

sa: तथैनं मनुजाः प्राहुर्भीमसेनं प्रियं तव। अथ केनानुभावेन सापत्नं जीवमिच्छसि॥
en: They say that Bhimasena is very dear to you. On what consideration, then do you desire for the life of a step brother?

sa: भूषितं तमलंकारैः कुण्डलैः परिहाटकैः। कम्बुपाणिनमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा सीदति मे मनः॥
en: Beholding him approaching me adorned with golden ear-rings and other ornaments and with wrists with bracelets of conches, my heart sinks into sorrow.

sa: यस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषात् समकम्पन्त शत्रवः। स्त्रियो गीतस्वनं तस्य मुदिताः पर्युपासते॥
en: The singing sound of that one, the sound of whose bow-string caused tremble to his enemies, is now courted by only delightful women.

sa: अमानयन् हि मानार्हान् वातापिश्च महासुरः। निहतो ब्रह्मदण्डेन तालजङ्घस्तथैव च।॥
en: Disregarding those that deserve honour, the great Asura, Vatapi, as well Talajangha, met with destruction by virtue of the curse of the Brahmanas.

sa: सुधन्वा च समागच्छत् प्राहादि केशिनी तथा। समागतं द्विजं दृष्ट्वा केशिनी भरतर्षभ। प्रत्युत्थायासनं तस्मै पाद्यमयं तदौ पुनः॥
en: Sudhanvan came to the son of Prahrada and Keshini; the latter, O best among the race if Bharata, having observed the approach of a Brahmana, rose up; and gave him water to wash his feet and the Arghya (mark of respect).

sa: इति कर्णवचः श्रुत्वा दुःखात् प्रवेपती। उवाच पुत्रमाश्लिष्य कर्णं धैर्यादकम्पनम्॥
en: Hearing these words of Karna Kunti trembled with sorrow and said to his after embracing him who being possessed of fortitude trembled not.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच जयद्रथस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य भ्रातरावुद्यतावुभौ। प्राधावत् तूर्णमव्यचो जीवितेऽप्सुः सुदुःखिताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Beholding the two brothers with upraised weapons, Jayadratha, desirous of living, stricken sorely with grief, ran away speedily and coolly.

sa: ततस्तान् सहसा दीर्णान् दृष्ट्वा वानरपुङ्गवान्। निर्ययौ कपिशार्दूलो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः॥
en: Seeing those foremost of monkeys run away all on a sudden, Hanuman, the brave of monkeys rallied them and stood ready (for battle).

sa: शल्य उवाच अथैनां रूपिणि साध्वीमुपातिष्ठदुपश्रुतिः। तां वयोरूपसम्पन्नां दृष्ट्वा देवीमुपस्थिताम्॥
en: Shalya said Then did beautiful Upashruti appear before the chaste one. Ard seeing the goddess possessed of youth and beauty appear before her.

sa: ततो दग्धाविमौ पक्षौ न दग्धौ तु जटायुषः। तदा मे चिरदृष्टः स भ्राता गृध्रपतिः प्रियः॥ निर्दग्धपक्षः पतितो ह्यहमस्मिन् महागिरौ।
en: In consequence of which my wings were burnt but those of Jatayu were not. That was the last time when I saw my dear brother, the king of the vultures. My wings being burnt I fell down and have been since lying on this mighty mountain."

sa: मृतानामपि चैतेषां विकृतं नैव जायते। मुखवर्णाः प्रसन्ना मे भ्रातृणामित्यचिन्तयत्॥
en: For, though dead, their features had undergone no change. And he thought "the colour on the face of my brothers is still lively.

sa: सर्वलोकादभिक्रुद्धान्न भयं विद्यते मम। किं तु सौहृदमेवैतत् कृपया मधुसूदन। सर्वास्तितिक्षे संक्लेशान् मा स्म नो भरता नशन्।।१८
en: I have no fear from all the worlds moved with wrath against me. But I am evincing these good wishes only out of mercy, O destroyer of Madhu. I can bear all sorts of troubles, if the Bharatas are not annihilated.

sa: क्षिपन्तौ शरजालानि मोहयामासतुर्नुपान्॥ व्यस्मयन्त ततो योधा ये तत्रासन् समागताः।
en: When they spread a net-work of arrows, they bewildered the kings. And all the warriors, that were present there, were filled with wonder.

sa: मृदुर्वदान्यो ब्रह्मण्यो दाता धर्मपरायणः। धर्मास्ते विदिता राजन् बहवो लोकसाक्षिकाः॥
en: You are mild, generous, religions, liberal and attached to virtue. O king, all the virtues known among men are also known to you.

sa: ततः कुशलपूर्वं हि मद्रराजोऽरिसूदनः। प्रीत्या परमया युक्तः समाश्लिष्यद् युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: And then that slayer of his enemies, the king of the Madras, having asked them about their health, embraced Yudhishthira, with great cheerfulness.

sa: असंशयमिदं कृष्णं महद् युद्धमुपस्थितम्। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च घोरं रुधिरकर्दमम्॥
en: Without doubt, O Krishna, a great calamity is at hand, the blood of the Pandavas and the Kurus will be the fierce clay.

sa: तथैव दिव्यं गाण्डीवं धनुरादाय पाण्डवः। शत्रुघ्नं वेगवान् हृष्टो भारसाधनमुत्तमम्॥
en: Taking up the best of bows, the celestials Gandiva, capable of destroying enemies and carrying a heavy weight, the son of Pandu delightedly.

sa: शस्त्रेण निधनं गच्छेत् समृद्धं क्षत्रमण्डलम्। कुरुक्षेत्रे पुण्यतमे त्रैलोक्यस्यापि केशव॥
en: The entire race of Kshatriyas will meet with death by weapons in Kurukshetra, the holiest spot in all the these worlds, O Keshava.

sa: हस्तेन ममृजे चैव ललाटं परवीरहा। भूयश्च त्वरितः क्रुद्धः सहसोत्थातुमैच्छत॥
en: That slayer of hostile heroes rubbed his forehead with his hand and incensed with ire desired many times to rise up in haste.

sa: ऋषयो ह्यपि निर्मुक्ताः पश्यन्तो लोकसंग्रहान्। सुखैर्भवन्ति सुखिनस्तथा दुःखेन दुःखिताः॥
en: Even the Rishis who are emancipated and who merely look on this crowd of men become happy at prosperity and aggrieved at adversity.

sa: बलवानहमित्येव न मन्तव्यं सुयोधन। बलवन्तो बलिभ्यो हि दृश्यन्ते पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: "I am strong", it should not be thought thus, O Suyodhana, for some parties are seen who are stronger than those among men.

sa: आर्यकर्मणि रज्यन्ते भूतिकर्माणि कुर्वते। हितं च नाभ्यसूयन्ति पण्डिता भरतर्षभ॥
en: Wise men rejoice in virtuous deeds and do those that tend to their prosperity and look not with contempt on what is good.

sa: सुवर्णमालाः कम्बूश्च कुण्डले परिहाटके। नानापत्तनजे शुभ्रे मणिरत्नं च शोभनम्॥
en: Let golden chains, couches, brilliant golden ear-rings of different countries, beautiful gems and jewels, silken garments and dcer skins be gathered for you.

sa: सागरस्तु ततः स्वप्ने दर्शयामास राघवम्। देवो नदनदीभर्ता श्रीमान् यादोगणैर्वृतः॥
en: Then that Lord of all the rivers, the ocean, surrounded by aquatic animals showed himself to the descendant of Raghu in a dream.

sa: रावण उवाच गन्धर्वदेवासुरतो यक्षराक्षसतस्तथा। सर्पकिन्नरभूतेभ्यो न मे भूयात् पराभवः॥
en: Ravana said: May I never meet with defeat at the hands of Gandharvas, celestials, Kinnaras Asuras, Yakshas, Rakshasas, Nagas and all other creatures.

sa: पादौ तव ग्रहीष्यन्ति भ्रातरः पञ्च पाण्डवाः। द्रौपदेयास्तथा पञ्च सौभद्रश्चापराजितः॥
en: The king and princes, assembled on the side of the Pandayas, will accept your feet as also all the Andhakas and the Vrishnis.

sa: विराट उवाच शतं सहस्राणि समाहितानि सवर्णवर्णस्य विमिश्रितान् गुणैः। पशून् सपालान् भवते ददाम्यहं त्वदाश्रया मे पशवो भवन्त्विह॥
en: Virata said I have a hundred thousand kine of various classes the merits of which have not yet been brought to light. I give you the charge of these beasts with their keepers. Let my beasts be henceforth in your keep.

sa: अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां मत्प्रसादात् पुराभवत्। कस्माच्चित् कारणात् पापः कञ्चित् कालमुपेक्षितः॥
en: Formerly, he was made, through my favour, indestructible of all the creatures. And for some reason I spared that sinful wretch for sometime.

sa: क्रोधः कामो लोभमोहौ विधित्सा कृपासूये मानशौको स्पृहा चा ईर्ष्या जुगुप्सा च मनुष्यदोषा वाः सदा द्वादशैते नराणाम्॥
en: Anger, desire, covetousness, ignorance of right and wrong, discontentment, unkindness, jealousy, vanity, grief, love, of pleasure, envy and a tendency to speak ill of others are the faults of men and these twelve ought ever to be avoided by human beings.

sa: अक्षय्याविषुधी दिव्यौ पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। तेन पार्थो रणे शूरस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: And because the high-souled son of Pandu, Partha, has a pair of inexhaustible celestials quivers, he remained in battle unmoved like a mountain.

sa: यस्मै देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति पुरुषाय पराभवम्। बुद्धि तस्यापकर्षन्ति सोऽवाचीनानि पश्यति॥
en: That man, to whom defeat has been sent by the gods, has his senses lost; and, therefore, he does stoop to mean acts.

sa: दुर्योधनेन निकृतो मनस्वी नो चेत् क्रुद्धः प्रदहेद् धार्तराष्ट्रान्। नाहं तथा हर्जुनाद् वासुदेवाद् भीमाद् वाहं यमयोर्वा बिभेमि॥
en: He. who has been banished by Duryodhana, is not evil-minded otherwise being wrathful he would have consumed all the sons of Dhritarashtra. I do not fear Arjuna, Vasudeva or even Bhima or the twins so I, in the same measure, fear.

sa: ज्ञातींस्तानवमुच्याथ राजदारांश्च सर्वशः। कृत्वा च दुष्करं कर्म प्रीतियुक्ताश्च पाण्डवाः॥
en: The Pandavas also, having rescued their relatives with the ladies of the royal household and having achieved that great feat, became exceedingly delighted.

sa: नेदृशं त पुनर्युद्धं भविष्यति कदाचन। अहो ज्ञानेन सम्पन्नाबुभौ ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियौ॥
en: Hardly, again, there will be a battle like this. 'O! these two personages, viz. this Brahmana and this Kshatriya are possessed of knowledge.

sa: व्यानं त्वं मन्यसेऽऽत्मानं यावत् कृष्णौ न पश्यसि। समास्थितावेकरथे सूर्याचन्द्रमसाविव॥
en: You consider yourself a lion for you have not seen Krishna and Arjuna stationed on the same car like the sun and moon.

sa: अद्यापुत्र सूतमाता भवित्री कुन्ती वाथो वा मया तेन वापि। सत्यं वदाम्यद्य न कर्णमाजी शरैरहत्वा कवचं विमोक्ष्ये॥
en: Today either dame Suta will be bereft of her son by me, or Kunti will be bereft of me by Karna. Verily do I tell you that I won't unlock my mail-cloak today without slaying Karna in battle with my arrows.

sa: धनुश्चिच्छेद भीमस्य राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्। हयांश्चास्य शितैर्बाणैः सारथिं च महाबलः॥
en: The highly puissant prince of the Rakshasas cut-off Bhima's bow. The again that mighty hero, with sharp arrows, slew Bhima's steeds and charioteer.

sa: तथा कौरवदायादो न्यस्तशस्त्रो महायशाः। हतो भूरिश्रवा राजशूरः सात्यकिना युधि॥
en: O monarch, similarly Bhurisravas, the heroic son of Somadatta, of great renown, the kinsman of the Kauravas, was slain in battle by Satyaki.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु विंशत्या कर्णशल्यौ त्रिभित्रिभिः। त एनमभिगर्जन्तो विध्यन्तश्च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Duryodhana pierced him with twenty, Karna with three shafts. And all of them roared at him and went on piercing him without remission.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्ततो राजा माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। भीमसेनश्च बलवान् सात्यकि पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Thereupon king Yudhishthira, the two sons of Madri begotten by Pandu and the mighty Bhimasena rushed to protect him of the Satvata race.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनस्याश्चन् हत्वा सूतं च पश्चभिः॥ धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्।
en: Then with five of these arrows he slew Duryodhana's four horses and his Suta charioteer and with another he cut-off his gilded bow.

sa: धनुरन्यत् समादाय तिष्ठ तिष्ठेत्युवाच ह। एतावदुक्त्वा शैनेयो जनसन्धं महोरसि॥
en: Then taking up another bow he said-wait. Having spoken these two words only, the grandson of Sini pierced Jalasandha on his broad chest.

sa: ग्रहणे धर्मराजस्य भारद्वाजोऽपि गृध्यति। शक्तश्चापि रणे द्रोणो निग्रहीतुं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: The son of Bharadvaja, eagerly longs to capture the very virtuous king Yudhishthira. Drona also is competent enough to afflict Yudhishthira in battle.

sa: राधेयः पाण्डवश्रेष्ठं शक्तः पीडयितुं रणे। सहितो धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रैः शूरैर्महाबलेः॥
en: Accompanied by the highly powerful and heroic sons of Dhritarashtra the son of Radha is capable of afflicting the Pandava chief in battle.

sa: तमेवं व्याकुलं भीमं भूयो भूयः शितैः शरैः। मूर्च्छयाभिपरीताङ्गमकरोत् सूतनन्दनः॥
en: But the son of Suta then repeatedly caused the already afflicted Bhima, to lose his senses by striking him with his sharp arrows.

sa: पञ्चालानां महेष्वासाः सर्वे युद्धिविशारदाः। द्रोणेन सह संगम्य गता वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: All the mighty bowmen among the Pandavas, who were expert in battle, departed to the region of Death, after having fought with Drona.

sa: तं भीमः सहसाभ्येत्य राक्षसान्तकरः प्रभो। सगणं राक्षसेन्द्रं तं शरवरवाकिरत्॥
en: Then, O master, that slayer of Rakshasa Bhima, furiously encountering that foremost of Rakshasas, covered him and his followers with showers of arrows.

sa: सोऽहं नारायणस्रेण महता शत्रुतापनः। शत्रून् विध्वंसयिष्यामि कदर्थी कृत्य पाण्डवान्॥
en: An afflicter of foes as I am, with the aid of that Narayana weapon, I shall destroy the foes, completely crushing the Pandavas.

sa: दुर्योधनेन च द्रोणस्तथोक्तः कुरुसंसदि। किमुक्तवान् परं तस्मै तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Relate to me, O Sanjaya, what Drona did say after he had been thus addressed by Duryodhana in the midst of the Kurus.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नो भृशोद्विग्नो नेत्राभ्यां पातयञ्जलम्। अभ्यवर्तते संग्रामे क्रुद्धो द्रोणरथं प्रति॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna was filled with rage and tears trickled down from his eyes. Then burning with rage, he rushed at the car of Drona.

sa: कृतवान् यानियुद्धानि कर्णः पाण्डुसुतैः सह। सर्वत्र पाण्डवाः कर्णमजयन्त रणाजिरे॥
en: In all the battles that Karna has fought with the sons of Pandu, the latter have worsted him on the field of battle.

sa: तत्र भारते पुत्रस्ते कृतवान् कर्म दुष्करम्। प्रतिविध्यहयानुप्रैः पातयामास सायकैः॥
en: There, O Bharata, your son performed a difficult feat in as much as he struck down the steeds of Prativindhya with fierce shafts.

sa: पार्थे तस्मिन् हते चैव युध्यते नूनमग्रणीः॥ सहायो नास्य वै कश्चित् तेन विन्दामि कश्मलम्। तस्मिन् कृष्णे हते नूनं युध्यते युद्धकोविदः॥ न हि मे शुध्यते भावस्तयोरेव परंतप।
en: Upon the slaughter to your brother, surely Krishna conversant with all modes of warfare, is battling with the Kurus. Bring me the intelligence of that foremost of men and of that mighty car-warrior of the Vrishni race. Who has ere now followed in the track of your brother that mighty car-warrior. I am also overwhelmed with distress on account of this last-mentioned mighty arm-hered.

sa: सेनाबिन्दुसुतः श्रेष्ठः शास्त्रवान् प्रहरन् युधि॥ बाबिकेन महाराज कौरवेन्द्रेण पातितः।
en: O monarch, having destroyed innumerable enemies in battle, Senavindu, that foremost of the Kurus, was himself slain by Balhika the great Kaurava prince,

sa: फुल्लता पङ्कजेनेव वक्त्रेण विहसन् बली। आजुहाव रणे यान्तं भीममाधिरथिस्तदा॥
en: Then the valorous son of Adhiratha, with his beautiful face like a blooming lotus lighted up with a smile, challenged Bhimasena as he

sa: विराटद्रुपदौ षड्भिः शतेन च शिखण्डिनम्॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं च विंशत्या द्रौपदेयांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः।
en: He pierced Virata and Drupada with six, Sikhadin with a hundred, Dhristadyumna with twenty and the sons of Draupadi with three arrows each.

sa: तज्जग्राह पिता मह्यमब्रवीच्चैव स प्रभुः। त्वं वधिष्यसि सर्वाणि शस्रवर्षाण्यनेकशः॥
en: My puissant father then received that weapon. The lord then thus spoke to me also. "You shall destroy many showers of celestial weapons.

sa: तत्तु भीमो महाबाहोः कर्णस्य चरितं रणे। नामृष्यत महाबाहुः क्रोधादुद्वत्तलोचनः॥
en: But the mighty armed Bhima with his eyes roiling in rage, did not for long, bear that conduct of Karna in battle patiently.

sa: अलम्बुषस्तु संक्रुद्धः कुन्तिभोजशरार्दितः। अशोभत भृशं लक्ष्म्या पुष्पाढ्य इव किंशुकः॥
en: Afflicting with the arrows of Kuntibhoja, Alambusha inflamed with wrath, appeared beautiful like a Kinshuka tree rich with the wealth of its flowers.

sa: ते रथैः कल्पितै राजन् हेमरूप्यविभूषितैः। सादिभिश्च गजैश्चैव परिवठ्ठः समन्ततः॥
en: Those warriors then surrounded on all sides the Satvata hero, with duly-equipped chariots decked with gold and gems and with horsemen and elephants.

sa: एष सैन्यानि शत्रूणां विधमामि शितैः शरै। निहतानाहवे पश्य पदात्यश्वरथाद्विपान्॥
en: Behold me crush these hostile forces with my own sharp arrows. Behold these footsoldiers, horses, car-warriors and elephants of the hostile force slain.

sa: शक्रतुल्यबलो युद्धे यमतुल्य: पराक्रमे। रामतुल्यस्तथास्त्रेण स कथं वै निषूदितः॥
en: He was in battle like Sakra himself and in prowess like Yama and like Rama in arins. How has he been killed then?

sa: तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ नरसिंहौ महारथौ। सायकैस्तु प्रतिच्छन्नं चक्रतुः खमजिह्मगैः॥
en: Roaring at each other like two bulls, those foremost of men, those two mighty carwarriors, covered the welkin with clouds of straight-going shafts.

sa: अद्य केशव राधेयमहं हत्वा सबान्धवम्॥ नन्दयिष्यामि राजानं धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्।
en: O Krishna, I will cheer up king Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, by slaying today the son of Radha with all his tribe.

sa: समां च विषमां चक्रुः खुरागैर्विकृतां महीम्। हयाः काञ्चनयोक्त्रास्ते केसरालम्बिभिर्युगैः॥
en: Steeds, in trappings of gold and with manes flowing down their yokes, began to paw and make the ground uneven with their hoops.

sa: गान्धारराजः शकुनिस्रस्तस्त्रस्ततरैः सह। हतं रुक्मरथं श्रुत्वा प्राद्रवत् सहितौ रथैः॥
en: Beholding him of the golden car slain, Sakuni the king of the Gandharvas, with his terrified and affrighted followers fled in all haste.

sa: अपयाते ततस्तस्मिन् धर्मपुत्रे युधिष्ठिरे॥ द्रोणपुत्रस्ततो राजन् प्रत्यगात् स महामनाः।
en: After Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, had thus fled from the field, O king, the highminded son of Drona also left the spot.

sa: द्वन्द्वानि तत्र यान्यासन् संसक्तानि पुरोदयात्। तान्येवाभ्युदिते सूर्ये समसज्जन्त भारत॥
en: The same soldiers, that were engaged with one another before sun rise, once more fought with each other, OBharata, after the sun rise.

sa: शरैश्चैनं सुबहुभिः क्रुद्धः संख्ये पराभिनत्। स छिन्नधन्वा बलवान् रथशक्तिं सुदारुणम्॥ वेगेनाविध्य चिक्षेप द्रोणपुत्ररथं प्रति। तामापतन्ती सहसा महोल्काभां शितैः शरैः॥ चिच्छेद समरे द्रौणिर्दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भीमो दृढमादाय कार्मुकम्॥ द्रौणिं विव्याध विशिखैः स्मयमानो वृकोदरः। ततो द्रौणिर्महाराज भीमसेनस्य सारथिम्॥ ललाटे दारयामास शरेणानतपर्वणा। सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता द्रोणपुत्रेण सारथिः॥
en: Inflamed with fury he then pierced Bhima himself with numerous shafts. Then the highly puissant Bhima, when his bow was cut-off, having whirled with impetuosity a lance hurled it at Ashvatthaman's car. But the son of Drona, displaying his great lightness of hands, cut-off by means of his keen-arrows that lance as it flew towards himself, burning like a flamebeam. Meanwhile the formidable Bhima taking up a very strong bow smilingly began to wound the son of Drona with innumerable arrows. Then the son of Drona, O king, pierced the forehead of Bhima's driver with a straightflying arrow. The latter then thus deeply pierced by the mighty son of Drona.

sa: सात्यकि त नरव्याघ्रं व्याघ्रदत्तरत्ववारयत्। शरैः सुनिशितैस्तीक्ष्णैः कम्पयन् वै मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Vyaghradatta held in check Satyaki that foremost of men and he caused the latter to tremble incessantly with his sharp shafts properly whetted.

sa: येन ब्रह्मास्रविदुषा पञ्चालाः सत्यजिन्मुखाः। कुर्वाणा मजये यत्न समूला विनिपातिताः॥
en: Indeed this preceptor with his Brahma weapon exterminated that whole Panchala division under Satyajit, who had been entering to bestow victory on me.

sa: शङ्खभेरीमृदङ्गानां कुञ्जराणां च गर्जताम्। विस्फारितविकृष्टानां कार्मुकाणां च कूजताम्॥ शब्दः समभवद् राजन् दिविस्पृग् भरतर्षभ। द्रवतां च पदातीनां शस्त्राणां पततामपि॥
en: The noise, O foremost of the Bharata race, created by the blowing of conchs, the bear of drums, the roar of elephants and the twang of bows stretched with force, reached the very heavens, O monarch. The tumult, made also by running foot-soldiers and falling weapons.

sa: यः कार्येभ्यो व्रतं कृत्वा तस्य नानोपपादयेत। न तत्फलमवाप्नोति एवमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: He who, having taken a vow on some set purpose, cannot redeem the same by acts, attains not the rewards of that vow.

sa: पाञ्चाल्यं त्वरयाविध्यन् सर्व एव महारथाः। स विद्धः सप्तभिवीरैर्दोणस्यार्थे महाहवे॥
en: Duryodhana pierced him with twenty and Shakuni with five arrows. Thus all the mighty car-warriors (of your army) quickly pierced the Panchala prince.

sa: तानवेक्ष्य नरश्रेष्ठ विमना दुःखितस्तदा। निःश्वसन् दीर्घमुष्णं च पुनः पाण्डवमभ्ययात्॥
en: O foremost of men, beholding them he became cheerless and filled with sorrow; then breathing like a snake, he once more assailed Bhima.

sa: अद्य मद्वाणनिर्दग्धं पतितं धरणीतले। द्रक्ष्यतस्त्वां रणे वीरौ सहितौ केशवार्जुनौ॥
en: Today the heroes, Keshava and Arjuna, will both behold you prostrate on the field of battle, consumed with the fire of my barrows.

sa: कृत्वा सुदुष्करं कर्म सैन्यमध्ये महाबलः। तव दर्शनमन्विच्छन् पाण्डवाभ्येति सात्यकिः॥
en: O son of Pandu, the puissant Satya is coming to you have achieved numerous difficult feats in the midst of the Kaurava host.

sa: सम्प्राप्ताः सिन्धुराजस्य समीपमनिवारताः॥ व्यायच्छन्ति च तत्रापि सर्व एवापराजिताः। यदि तावद् रणे पार्थो व्यतिक्रान्तो महारथः॥ कथं सात्यकिभीमाभ्यां व्यतिक्रान्तोऽसि मानद।
en: Have succeeded in reaching near the ruler of the Sindhus, O slayer of foes. There they are fighting-all these indomitable and mighty car warriors vanquishing all our troops. But O giver of honour, how is it, that you have today been transgressed by Bhima and Satyaki?

sa: नकुलस्तु ततः कर्णं प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्। चिरस्य बत दृष्टोऽहं दैवतैः सौम्यचक्षुषा॥
en: Thereupon, Nakula smilingly uttered these words of Karna-'I am, after a long while and through the kindness of the celestials, seen by you.

sa: सहं युद्धं हि मे ताभ्यां साम्पराये भविष्यति। तदाचिद् विजयस्यामस्त्रहेतोरटन्नृप॥
en: There I have no fear from Partha or Janardana. There shall take place an encounter between me and them both in the battle.

sa: मृदुपूव तु राधेयो भीममाजावयोधयत्। क्रोधपूर्व तथा भीमः पूर्व वैरमनुस्मरन्॥
en: In that battle the son of Radha fought mildly with Bhima, but Bhima fought with the former wrathfully remembering all their former hostilities.

sa: सात्वतोऽपि महाराज तं विव्याध स्तनान्तरे॥ त्रिभिरेव महाभागः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः।
en: He, of the Satvata race of eminent parts o mighty monarch, again pierced him on the breast with three arrows of straight knots.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं तु पाञ्चाल्यं क्रूरैः सार्धं प्रभद्रकैः। आवन्त्यः सहसौवीरैः क्रुद्धरूपमवारयत्॥
en: The prince of Avanti supported by the Sauviras and the ruthless ruthless Prabhadrakas opposed Dhristadyumna the Panchala prince whose very appearance reflected wrath.

sa: इत्येवं व्यक्तमाभाष्य प्रतिभाष्य च सात्यकिः॥ अभ्ययात् तूर्णमव्यग्रो दयां नाकुरुतात्मनि।
en: Having thus replied to king Duryodhana and said his say, O king, Satyaki dauntlessly and reckless of his life, rushed furiously upon Duryodhana.

sa: अविषद्यं तु पार्थस्य शरसमप्तामाहवे। मत्वा न्यवर्तन् कुरवो जिता गाण्डीवधन्वना॥
en: The Kauravas, beaten by Partha, the wielder of the Gandiva, not being able to bear the brunt of the battle, gave up fighting.

sa: ते जग्मुर्धरणीमाशु कर्ण निर्भिद्य पत्रिणः। यथा जलधरं भित्त्वा दिवाकरमरीचयः॥
en: Those winged shafts piercing Karna through, fell down on the earth like the rays of the sun penetrating through masses of rain clouds.

sa: तस्मिन् सैन्यमहावर्ते पातालतलसंनिभे॥ निमग्न त रथं मत्वा नेदुः संशप्तकास्नथा।
en: Considering his car drowned into that whirlpool of warriors resembling the bed of the was nether region the Samsaptakas sent up loud war-cries.

sa: ततः प्रध्यमाष्य जलजं भेरीशतसमखनम्। अक्षुभ्यत बलं हर्षादूर्भूत इव सागरः॥
en: Then blowing his conch whose blast resembled the sound of a hundred Bheris, he agitated the hostile array that resembled the surging sea.

sa: तथैव भीमसेनेन लोकः संवदते भृशम्॥ कथं द्रोणो जित: संख्ये धनुर्वेदस्य पारगः। इत्येवं ब्रुवते योधा अश्रद्धेयमिदं तव॥
en: People are saying 'How is it that Drona that master of archery has been defeated by Bhimasena indeed all warriors are thus speaking and it should be disgraceful to you. I see that the destruction of my unfortunate self is inevitable.

sa: हन्यमानमथात्मानं परेभ्यो बहवो जनाः। नाभ्यजानन्त समरे निद्रया मोहिता भृशम्॥
en: Many of the enemy, entirely confounded in sleep, were slain without being conscious of the strokes that put an end to their existence.

sa: तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः॥ गदां चिक्षेप सहसा धर्मपुत्राय मारिष।
en: Thereupon Drona, that crusher of foes, leaving aside the severed bow hurled, O sire, quickly a mace upon the son of Dharma (Yudhishthira).

sa: असिचर्माणि चापानि शिरांसि कवचानि च। विप्रकीर्यन्त शूराणां सम्प्रहारे महात्मनाम्॥
en: In that battle between illustrious combatants, many swords, bucklers, bows, heads and armours of heroes, were seen lying scattered all over the field.

sa: ततो बाणांश्चतुःष्टिं तव पुत्रो महारणे। सहदेवरथं तूर्णं प्रेषयामास भारत॥
en: Thereupon, O descendant of the Bharata race, your son most rapidly directed sixty-four arrows against the car of Shahadeva, in that dreadful battle.

sa: वध्यन्ते समरे वीराः शतथोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ ततो रथादवप्लुत्य वेगमास्थाय पाण्डवः।
en: Numerous heroes were slain by hundreds and by thousands. Then jumping down from his car and rushing with fury, the son of Pandu.

sa: विसृजन विशिखांस्तीक्ष्णान् स्वर्णपुङ्खाञ्छिलाशितान्। तं तु भीमोऽभ्ययात् तूर्ण वार्यमाणः सुतैस्तव॥
en: Although opposed by your sons, yet Bhima then quickly rushed against Karna shooting sharp arrows, furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone.

sa: तामापतन्ती सहसा गदां दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरः॥ गादामेवाग्रहीत् क्रुद्धश्चिक्षेप च परंतप।
en: Then beholding that mace fall quickly upon himself, king Yudhishthira took up another mace and afflicter of your foes, he also hurled it.

sa: वरान् प्रादाद् बहुविधान् भार्गवाय महात्मने। उक्तश्च देवदेवन प्रीतियुक्तेन शूलिना॥
en: Thereupon the illustrious lord, being gratified by that deed of his, gave to that highsouled descendant of Bhrigu's race various kinds of boons.

sa: धनंजय भयात् कर्णमुजिहीर्षन् महारथः ततो द्रौणिं चतुःषष्ट्या विव्याध कुपितोऽर्जुनः॥
en: Desirous as he was of freeing Karna from his fear of Dhananjaya. Thereupon Arjuna inflamed with rage, pierced Drona's son with sixty-four arrows.

sa: सचिवो वृषवर्मा ते शूरः परमवीर्यवान्। भीमसेनेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम्॥
en: Your highly energetic minister, the Suta Vrisavarman, was sent to the abode of Death by Bhimasena, who displayed his superior prowess in battle.

sa: श्रुतकीर्तिस्तथा शल्यं माद्रीपुत्रः सुतं तव। दुःशासनं महाराज सहदेवः प्रतापवान्॥
en: O mighty monarch, so again, Shrutakirti closed with Shalya; and that son of Madri, Shahadeva of immense prowess, closed with your son, Dussashana.

sa: यमौ च युयुधानश्च पाण्डवश्च वृकोदरः। जित्वा रथसहस्राणि तावकानां महारथाः।
en: So did also the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) and Yuyudhana, the Pandu's son Vrikodara. Having vanquished thousands of energetic kings of your army.

sa: अद्य पापास्य तद् वाक्यं सुवर्णविकृताः शराः।।९० शमयन्तु शिलाधौतास्त्वयास्ता जीवितच्छिदः।
en: Let your gold-plated and sharpened shafts, capable of dealing death to the living today assuage the sorrows caused by those words of effrontery.

sa: पुनस्तमागतं दृष्ट्वा शैनेयिा निशितैः शरैः। अदारयत् क्रूरतरैः पुन: पुनररिंदम॥
en: But the grandson of Shini that subduer of foes seeing him once more proceed against him, ruthlessly pierced him with numerous sharp arrows.

sa: तं सात्यकिः प्रत्यविध्यत् तथैवावाकिरच्छरैः॥ पञ्चाशता पुनश्चाजौ त्रिंशता दशभिश्च ह।
en: Satyaki quickly pierced Duryodhana in return with fifty keen shafts in that battle and then with twenty and next with another ten shafts.

sa: ततो बाणमयं जालं भीमसेनस्थं प्रति। कर्णेन विहितं राजन् निमेषार्धाददृश्यत॥
en: O king, thereafter, a net-work-of arrows was woven, within the twinkling of an eye, around the car of Bhima by the mighty Karna.

sa: नित्यमेव शृगालस्तवं नित्यं सिंहो धनंजयः। वीरप्रद्वेषणान्मूढ तस्मात् क्रोष्टेव लक्ष्यसे॥
en: You are always a jackal and Dhananjaya always a lion. On account of your envy and hatred for heroes, you appear a jackal.

sa: अथ पाण्डुसुताः सर्वे परिवार्य युधिष्ठिरम्॥ अन्वयुः समरे राजंस्ततो युद्धमवर्तत।
en: Thereupon, O monarch, all other sons of Pandu, collected round Yudhishthira and rushed forth at that battle, whereupon a great encounter took place.

sa: तेषामापततां शब्दस्तीव्र आसीद् विशाम्पते॥ उवृत्तानां यथा वृष्ट्या सागराणां भयावहः।
en: O king, the army, dashing impetuously against the enemies, caused a tumult resembling the terrible noise made by many oceans swollen with rams.

sa: तेजस्तेजः समासाद्य प्रशमं याति भारत॥ अशक्या तरसा जेतुं पाण्डवानामनीकिनी।
en: (Therefore) one energy encountering the other is neutralising (each other). O Bharata. (We are) incapable of putting down the Pandava's army by force.

sa: जयरातरथं प्राप्य मुहुः सिंह इवानदत्। जयरातमथाक्षिप्य नदन् सव्येन पाणिना॥
en: Got up to the car of Jayadratha and repeatedly sent forth leoninc roars. While roaring he hurled him down with his left hand.

sa: ताभ्यां मुक्ताः शरा राजन् गार्धपत्राश्चकाशिरे। श्रेण्यः शरदि मत्तानां सारसानामिवाम्बरे॥
en: O king, the arrows, furnished with vulterince wings and discharged by Bhima, appeared beautiful like rows of maddened swans ranging through the welkin.

sa: सहस्रशश्च रथिनः पातितः पतितायुधाः॥ ते क्षताः समदृश्यन्त भीमभीता गतासवः।
en: Thousands of car-warriors, deprived of their arms, lay senseless through the fear of Bhima and inany lay dead, their bodies mangled with wounds.

sa: तस्माद् रक्षत संग्रामे द्रोणमेव महारथम्॥ इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठ पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव।
en: Therefore protect (carefully) the mighty car-warrior Drona in battle." Thus addressing (his soldiers), your son Duryodhana, 0 foremost of the descendants of Bharata.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। कश्मलं चाविशत् तीव्र विराटो भरतर्षभ॥
en: The mighty car-warrior Virata thus pierced home by the puissant (Shalya) sat down on the terrace of his car and soon fainted away.

sa: स विमुक्तो बलवता शैनेयेन शरोत्तमः। घोरस्तस्योरसि विभो निपपाताशु भारत॥
en: Shot with great force by the grandson of Sini that excellent and formidable shaft, darted like a falcon, at the chest of Somadatta.

sa: पञ्चालान् केकयांश्चैव वृष्णींश्चापि समागतान्। बाणौधैः शकलीकृत्य तव दास्यामि मेदिनीम्॥
en: The Panchalas, the Keykayas and the assembled Vrishnis. (And) cutting (them) off into pieces with arrows I will give the earth to you.

sa: ततः सुनिशितैर्बाणैः पार्थ विव्याध सप्तभिः। युधिष्ठिरोऽपि संक्रुद्धः प्रतिविव्याध पञ्चभिः॥
en: Then, (Drona) pierced the son of Pritha with seven sharpened darts. Yudhishthira also, inflamed with rage, pierced him in return with five (arrows).

sa: कश्मलं प्राविशन् घोरं नान्वजानन् परस्परम्॥ ते शरैर्भिन्नमर्माणः सैनिकाः पार्थचोदितैः।
en: They were dreadfully confused and could not recognise one another. Your troops urged on by fate, having their vitals torn open by arrows.

sa: स त्वमेकशतं पातं पतन्नभ्यधिको मया। कथमेवं परिश्रान्तः पतितोऽसि महार्णवे॥
en: You, who would fly in a hundred different ways, are superior to me; why are you then tired and fallen on the ocean?"

sa: एवमेतन्महाराज नरवाजिरथद्विपान्॥ हत्वा तस्थौ महेष्वासः कर्णोऽरिगणसूदनः। यथा भूतगणान् हत्वा कालस्तिष्ठेन्महाबलः॥ तथा स सोमकान् हत्वा तस्थावेको महारथः।
en: O great monarch, after destroying hosts of elephants, horses, infantry and car-warriors, that powerful archer, the destroyer of his enemies, stood upon his chariot. The great carwarrior Karna after killing the Somakas stood like the mighty Pluto after destroying the elephants.

sa: ते भीमभयसंत्रस्तावका भरतर्षभ। विहाय समरे भीमं दुद्रुवः दिशो दश॥
en: O foremost of Bharatas, filled with anxiety consequent upon the fear of Bhima, your troops avoided him and fled away in all directions.

sa: यस्तु शूद्रैः समश्नीयाद् ब्राह्मणोऽप्येकभोजने। अशौचं विधिवत् तस्य शौचमत्र विधीयते॥
en: The Brahmana who take his food in the company of Shudras, is purged from all impurities by duly performing the ceremonies of purifications.

sa: तमुत्थितं महात्मानं लब्धसंज्ञं मनस्विनम्। समीक्ष्य पितरं स्वस्थं ववन्दे बभ्रुवाहनः॥
en: Seeing his father, the great hero of in exhaustible energy, restored to consciousness and quite at his case, Babhruvahana adored him with respect.

sa: तमुवाचोरगपतेर्दुहिता प्रहसन्निवा न मे त्वमपराद्धोऽसि न हि मे बभ्रुवाहनः॥
en: To him, the daughter of the Prince of Snakes answered sinilingly, You have not offended me, nor has Babhruvahana done me any wrong.

sa: घोरं च निनदं तस्य पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम्। श्रुत्वा विशीर्येद्धृदयं देवानामपि संयुगे॥
en: His roars are terrible, like the mutterings of clouds. Hearing those roars in battle, the very hearts of the celestials break in twain.

sa: नापिधायाश्रमं शक्यो रक्षितुं पाकशासनः॥ उटजं वा तथा ह्यस्य नानाविधसरूपता।
en: Indra cannot be kept out by enclosing this retreat of ours or fencing this yard, since he is capable of assuming numberless forms.

sa: स वत्सरः स ऋतुः सोऽर्धमासः सोऽहोरात्रः स कला वै स काष्ठाः। मात्र मुहूर्ताश्च लवाः क्षणाश्च विष्वक्सेनः सर्वमेतत् प्रतीहि॥
en: He is the Ycar; He is the Season; He is the Fortnights; He is the Day and the Night; He is those divisions of time which are called Kalas, and Kashthas, and Matras, and Muhurtas, and Lavas, and Kshanas, Know that this Vishvaksena is all these.

sa: परया भारतश्रेष्ठ पूजया समवस्थितौ। ततस्ताभ्यामनुज्ञातो ययौ येन हयो गतः॥
en: The two elderly chiefs honoured Arjuna duly. Getting their permission, the Kuru prince then proceeded to where the horse he followed lied him.

sa: स तमाभाष्य राजानमब्रवीद् द्विजसत्तमः। तोषमिपम्यहं क्षिप्रं यथा तुष्टो भविष्यति॥
en: That best of twiceborn persons, addressing the king, O monarch, said these words-I shall soon satisfy you. The Rishi also will be satisfied.

sa: तस्मादेतान् नरो नित्यं दूरतः परिवर्जयेत्॥ एतत् ते च्यवनस्यापि कर्म राजन् प्रकीर्तितम्। ब्रवीम्यहं ब्रूहि वा त्वं क्षत्रियं ब्राह्मणाद् वरम्॥
en: Hence, one should always renounce these faults to a great distance. Thus, O king, I have described to you thc fcat achieved by Chyavana. Shall I go on? Or, will you say anything in reply? Is there a Kshatriya who is higher than the Brahmana Chyavana?

sa: च्यवन् कृतवानेतावश्विनौ सोमपायिनौ। ततः प्रत्याहरत् कर्म मदं च व्यभजन्मुनिः॥
en: Thus did Chyavana make the Ashvins drinkers of Soma with the other gods. Calling back Mada, the Rishi then assigned him his work.

sa: तत्र वेदविदो राजंश्चक्रुः कर्माणि याजकाः। परिक्रमन्तः सर्वज्ञा विधिवत् साधुशिक्षितम्॥
en: The priests, well-conversant with the Vedas, did every rite, duly, moving about in all directions. They were all well-trained, and possessed of omniscience.

sa: पवित्रमथ चायुष्यं पितॄणामक्षयं च तत्। सुवर्णं मनुजेन्द्रेण हरिश्चन्द्रेण कीर्तितम्॥
en: King Harishchandra said that the gift of gold washes off sins, leads to long life, and yields inexhaustible merit to the departed means.

sa: ततस्तं वारणं क्रुद्धः शरजालेन पाण्डवः। निवारयामास तदा बेलेव मकरालयम्॥
en: Worked up with rage, Dhananjaya impeded the course of that beast with a shower of arrows like the shore resisting the surging sea.

sa: स तेन प्रेषितो राज्ञा मेघवद् विनदन् मुहुः। मुखाडम्बरसंहादैरभ्यद्रवत फाल्गुनम्॥
en: Indeed, urged on by the king, the elephant, repeatedly roaring like a cloud, rushed towards Phalguna, sending forth deep noise from its mouth.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच शतवर्षजीवी यश्च शूरो मनुष्यो वेदाध्यायी यश्च यज्वाऽप्रमत्तः। एते सर्वे शक्रलोकं व्रजन्ति परं गन्ता धृतराष्ट्रो न तत्र॥
en: Dhritarashtra said He who lives for a hundred years, who is gifted with heroism, who studies the Vedas and who celebrates sacrifices with devotion, indeed, such men proceed to the region of Shakra. I shall go to a higher region, Indeed, Dhritarashtra shall not go there.

sa: एवं वृत्तानि युद्धानि तत्र तत्र महीयते। अर्जुनस्य महीपालै नादेशसमागतैः॥
en: Thus took place innumerable battles in various countries, O monarch, between Arjuna and the kings of various realms who came to encounter him.

sa: अवमृद्नन् स राष्ट्राणि पार्थिवानां हयोत्तमः। शनैस्तदा परिययौ श्वेताश्वश्च महारथः॥
en: Grinding the kingdoms of many kings that excellent horse wandered. And it was followed slowly by the great car-warrior Arjuna of white horses.

sa: एतद्धि भीमनिर्हादं विश्रुतं गाण्डिवं धनुः। स्वस्ति गच्छत्वरिष्टो वै पन्थानमकुतोभयम्॥
en: That is the celebrated bow Gaudiva of terrible twang. Blessed be you. let all dangers fly your path. Let fear nowhere inspire you.

sa: मया चैतत् प्रतिज्ञातं रणमूर्धनि केशवा अभिमन्यौ हते वीर त्वामेष्याम्यचिरादिति।॥
en: I had, before this, vowed, O Keshava, that if Abhimanuyu fell on the field of battle, O hero, I would follow him immediately.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच कुतो दुःखं मानसं देहजं वा पाण्डुर्विवर्णश्च कुतस्त्वमद्या आचक्ष्व मे ब्राह्मण यावदेतान् निहन्मि सर्वांस्तव दुःखकर्तृन्॥
en: Indra said Whence then is this pain, mental or physical, and why are you pale and changed in appearance at present, tell me, O Brahmana, who those people are, who have caused you pain, so that I may slay them all.

sa: परुषाण्यपि चोक्ता या दृष्टा दुष्टेन चक्षुषा। सुप्रसन्नमुखी भर्तुर्या नारी सा पतिव्रता॥ च चन्द्रसूर्यो न तरुं पुनाम्ना या निरीक्षते। भर्तृवर्जं वरारोहा सा भवेद् धर्मचारिणी॥ दरिद्रं व्याधितं दीनमध्वना परिकर्शितम्। पति पुत्रमिवोपास्ते सा नारी धर्मभागिनी॥ या नारी प्रयता दक्षा या नारी पुत्रिणी भवेत्। पतिप्रिया पतिप्राणा सा नारी धर्मभागिनी॥
en: That woman who is gifted with self-control, who has given birth to children, who serves her husband with devotion, and whose whole heart is devoted to him, is considered as truly righteous in her conduct. That woman who waits upon and serves her husband with a cheerful heart, who is always cheerful of heart, and who is gifted with humility, is considered as truly righteous in her conduct. That woman who always supports his kinsmen and relatives by giving them food, and whose desire for gratifying her wishes or for articles of enjoyment, or for riches or for happiness, falls short of her devotion to her husband, is considered as truly righteous in her conduct.

sa: एवमुक्ते ततः कुन्ती पर्यगृह्णाज्जनार्दनः। भूमौ निपतितां चैनां सान्त्वयामास भारत॥
en: After Kunti had said so, Janardana took hold of her, O Bharata, and gently raising her from the Earth, comforted her as follows.

sa: एषा सरस्वती पुण्या नदीनामुत्तमा नदी। प्रथमा सर्वसरितां नदी सागरगामिनी॥
en: The sacred Sarasvati is the foremost river of all rivers. She goes towards the ocean and is truly the first of all rivers.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र प्रहितो गच्छ मरुत्तं संवर्तेन संगतं तं वदस्व। बृहस्पतिं त्वमुपशिक्षस्व राजन् वज्रं वा ते प्रहरिष्यामि घोरम्॥
en: Therefore, O Dhritarashtra, according to my direction go to king Marutta, attended by Samvarta, and deliver this now to him-do you, O prince, accept Brihaspati as your spiritual preceptor, as otherwise, I shall strike you with my dreadful thunderbolt.' do you

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सम्पूजितो राजा पाण्डवैरम्बिकासुतः। विजहार यथापूर्वमृषिभिः पर्युपासितः॥
en: Thus adored by the Pandavas, the royal son of Ambika passed his time happily as before, waited upon and honoured by the Rishis.

sa: स वध्यमानो वज्रेण सुभृशं भूरितेजसा॥ तोयं जग्राह विषयं ततः।
en: And being deeply wounded by the thunderbolt of powerful Indra, Vritra entered into the (waters), and by doing so, he destroyed their property.

sa: परिमाणं विदित्वा च दण्डं दण्ड्येषु भारत॥ प्रणयेयुर्यथान्यायं पुरुषास्ते युधिष्ठिर।
en: Let your judicial officers, O Yudhishthira, mete out punishments, according to the law, on offenders after careful determining the gravity of the offenses.

sa: अस्य चैवर्षिसंघस्य मम च प्रियकाम्यया। एतं ममेह संदेहं वक्तुमर्हस्यरिंदम॥
en: For benefiting this large number of Rishis, as also myself, do you kindly remove, O chaister of all enemies, this doubt of mine.

sa: सुवर्णमेव सर्वासु दक्षिणासु विधीयते। सुवर्णे ये प्रयच्छन्ति सर्वदास्ते भवन्त्युत॥
en: Of all kinds of presents, gold is the best. They who make gifts of gold are said to be givers of all things,

sa: इति तेषां कथयतां भगवान् वृषभध्वजः। एवमस्त्विति देवांस्तान् विप्रर्षे प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: To the deities that said so, the holy Mahadeva having the bull for his sign, O twiceborn Rishi, answered, saying, So be it!

sa: एवमेतन्महाराज राजा सम्यक् समाचरन्। प्रेत्य स्वर्गमवाप्नोति प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्॥
en: The king, O monarch, by acting properly according to these ways, attains to Heaven hereafter, after ruling his subjects piously in this world.

sa: एवं महात्मना तेन त्रील्लोकान् जनमेजय। परिक्रम्याहृते दिव्ये ततस्ते मणिकुण्डले॥
en: It was thus, O Janamejaya, that the great Utanka, having wandered through the three worlds, fetched, those jewelled ear-rings (for his preceptor's wife).

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एवमेतत् करिष्यामि यथाऽऽत्थ पृथिवीपते। भूयश्चैवानुशास्योऽहं भवता पार्थिवर्षभ॥
en: Yudhishthira said O king, I shall do as you order me. O foremost of kings, I should be be further instructed by you.

sa: तस्य लोकस्य च द्वारं स ददर्श भृगूद्वहः। पञ्चयोजनविस्तारमायतं शतयोजनम्॥
en: That perpetuator of Bhrigu's race saw the gate of that region which was full five Yojanas high and a hundred Yojanas in width.

sa: न स्वल्पमपि पुत्रस्ते व्यलीकं कृतवान् नृद! पितरीव सुविश्वस्तास्तस्मिन्नपि नराधिपे॥
en: Your son, O monarch, never did us the slightest wrong. We lived, depending on that king as trustfully as on our own father.

sa: ब्रह्मा पितामहः पूर्वं देवताभिः प्रसादितः। इमे नः संतरिष्यन्ति प्रजाभिर्जगतीश्वराः॥
en: The Grandfather Brahman was, formerly propitiated by all the deities who said to him, Let these lords of the universe save us all.

sa: स त्वां कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ किंचिदर्थमभीप्सति। श्राद्धमिच्छति दातुं स गाङ्गेयस्य महात्मनः॥ द्रोणस्य सोमदत्तस्य बालीकस्य च धीमतः। पुत्राणां चैव सर्वेषां ये चान्ये सुहृदो हताः॥ यदि चाप्यनुजानीषे सैन्धवापसदस्य च।
en: He now solicits from you, O foremost of Kuru's race, some money. He wishes to perform the Shraddha of the great son of Ganga, as also of Drona and Somadatta and Vallika of great intelligence, and of all his sons as also of all other wishers of his who have been killed, and, if you permit it, of that wicked king of the Sindhus.

sa: तस्याशिषः प्रयुज्याथ स मुनिस्तं नराधिपम्॥ निषीदेत्यब्रवीद् धीमान् सान्त्वयन् पुरुषर्षभः।
en: Uttering a benediction upon the king, the Rishi, gifted with great intelligence, O king, comforted the king and saidSit down on that seat.

sa: अर्हस्त्वमपि दातुं वै नादातुं भरतर्षभ। एवं ब्रुवाणं वीभत्सुं धर्मराजोऽप्यपूजयत्॥
en: You should give instead of refusing, O chief of Bharata's race!' Bibhatsu who was saying so was applauded by king Yudhishthira the just.

sa: तस्मिन् विमाने सौवर्णे मणिस्तम्भसमाकुले। महार्हे शयने दिव्ये शयानं भृगुनन्दनम्॥
en: In that golden palace having columns made of jewels and gems, the son of Bhrigu lay stretched on a costly and excellent bed.

sa: वधूपरिवृता राज्ञि नगरं गन्तुमर्हसि। राजा यात्वेष धर्मात्मा तापस्ये कृतनिश्चयः॥
en: You should, O queen, return to the city, accompanied by these your daughters-in-law! This king, goes to the forest, determined upon practicing penances.

sa: इति पृष्टा सुमनया मधुरं चारुहासिनी। शाण्डिली निभृतं वाक्यं सुमनामिदमब्रवीत्॥ नाहं कापायवसना नापि वल्कलधारिणी। च जटिला भूत्वा देवत्वमागता॥ अहितानि च वाक्यानि सर्वाणि परुषाणि च। अप्रमत्ता च भर्तारं कदाचिन्नाहमब्रुवम॥
en: Thus questioned swectly by Sumana, Stiandili of sweet smiles, addressing her fair interrogatrix, thus answered her silently. I did not wear yellow robes; nor barks of trees. I did not shave my head; nor did I keep matted locks on my head. It is not on account of these deeds that I have acquired the status of a celestial. I never carelessly addressed any harsh words to my husband.

sa: इति बाष्पकला वाचः कुन्ती पुत्रस्य शृण्वती। सा जगामाश्रुपूर्णाश्री भीमस्तामिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Kunti, with tears in her eyes, heard these words of her son, but continued to go her way. Then Bhima addressed her, saying,

sa: याथातथ्येन भगवन् वक्तुमर्हसि मेऽनघ। इति सम्परिपृष्टोऽहं तेन विप्रेण माधव॥
en: O' holy one, you should tell me all this accurately, O sinless one' Thus was I accosted by that learned Brahimana, O Madhava?

sa: यानीहागमशास्त्राणि याश्च काश्चित् प्रवृत्तयः। तानि वेदं पुरस्कृत्य प्रवृत्तानि यथाक्रमम्॥
en: All scriptures, religious treatises, and rites that are seen in the world, have all originated from the Vedas, according to their due order.

sa: वहन्ति मामतिबला: कुञ्जरा हेममालिनः। स्यन्दनेषु च काम्बोजा युक्ताः परमवाजिनः॥
en: Elephants of great strength, decked with golden chains, carry me on their backs. To my cars are yoked Kamboja horses of High mettle.

sa: ख्यातिर्यस्याः खं दिवंगां च नित्यं पुरा दिशो विदिशश्चावतस्थे। तस्या जलं सेव्य सरिद्वराया माः सर्वे कृतकृत्या भवन्ति॥
en: The fame of Ganga has spread all over the sky, and Heaven, and Earth, and all the points, cardinal and subsidiary, of the compass. By using the waters of that foremost of rivers, mortal creatures always become crowned with high success.

sa: तत्राहमिदमश्रौषं शक्रस्य वदतः खयम्। वर्षाणि त्रीणि शिष्टानि राज्ञोऽस्य परमायुषः॥
en: There I heard from the lips of Shakra himself that there are three years yet of the period of life of this king.

sa: द्रौपदी हतपुत्रा च सुभद्रा चैव भाविनी। नातिप्रीतियुते देव्यो तदाऽऽस्तामप्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: Draupadi had lost all her children, and the beautiful Subhadra also had become childless. They, too, were of cheerless hearts and grieved greatly.

sa: घोषिणी जातनिर्घोषा नित्यमेव प्रवर्तते। तयोरपि च घोषिण्या निर्घोषैव गरीयसी॥
en: Word always comes as endued with ulterance or unendued with it. Amongst those two. Word without utterance is superior to Word with utterance.

sa: निर्यातयत मे सेनां प्रभूतरथकुञ्जराम्। द्रक्ष्यामि वनसंस्थं च धृतराष्ट्रं महीपतिम्॥
en: 'Cause my army, full of cars and elephants, to march out. I shall see king Dhritarashtra who is now living in the forest.

sa: स बहिर्दिवसानेव जनौघं परिपालयन्। न्यवसन्नृपतिः पञ्च ततोऽगच्छद् वनं प्रति॥
en: Going out of his city, king Yudhishthira waited five days for such citizens as might accompany him and then went towards the forest.

sa: ते तमूचुस्ततो वाक्यं यमुनामवगाहितुम्। युष्याणामुदकुम्भस्य चार्थे गत इति प्रभो॥
en: They answered, O monarch, telling him that he had gone to the Yamuna, for his ablutions, as also for fetching flowers and waters.

sa: न चान्नाज्जायते तस्मिन् सूक्ष्मो नाम व्यतिक्रमः॥ मनसा गम्यते यच्च यच्च वाचा निगद्यते। श्रोत्रेण श्रूयते यच्च चक्षुषा यच्च दृश्यते॥ स्पर्शेन स्पृश्यते यच्च घ्राणेन घ्रायते च यत्। मनःषष्ठानि संयम्य हवींष्येतानि सर्वशः॥ गुणवत्पावको मह्यं दीव्यतेऽत:शरीरगः।
en: The minutest sin does not arise in him from the food he takes.
