Whatever is thought of by the mind, whatever is uttered by words, whatever is heard by the ear, whatever is seen by the eye, whatever is touched by touch, whatever is smelt by the nosc, form oblations of clarified butter which should all, after controlling the senses with the mind numbering the sixth, be poured into that fire of high merits which burns within the body viz., the Soul.

sa: अन्नमेव प्रशंसन्ति देवर्षिपितृमानवाः। अन्नस्य हि प्रदानेन रन्तिदेवो दिवं गतः॥
en: The deities Rishis, departed manes, and men, all praise food. Formerly king Rantideva, proceeded to the celestial region by making gifts of food.

sa: तेषां तु पुरुषेन्द्राणां रुदतां रुदितस्वनः॥ प्रासादाभोगसंरुद्ध अन्वरौत्सीत् स रोदसी॥
en: The sound of lamentations uttered by those weeping heroes, filling the spacious chambers of the palace, escaped therefrom and penetrated the very sky.

sa: पुत्रस्य मातापितरौ यस्य रुष्टावुभावपि। गुर्वपध्यानतः सोऽपि मृतो जायति गर्दभः॥
en: That son with whom his parents become angry has on account of his evil thoughts towards them, to take birth as an ass.

sa: अन्यान् बाणान् समीक्षस्व यैस्त्वं मां सूदयिष्यसि। तच्छुत्वाप्यविचिन्त्याथ ततो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Do you look out for other arrows with which 10 kill me! Hearing these words and reflecting upon them, he said as follows.

sa: तेन नोऽविहिता प्रज्ञा मनश्च बहुलीकृतम्। एतदाख्यातमिच्छामः श्रेयः किमिति सत्तम॥
en: Therefore our understanding breaks down and our mind is distracted. We, therefore, wish, O best of all beings, to know what is good.

sa: मेने दिविष्ठमात्मानं तुष्ट्या परमया युतः। ततस्ते भीष्ममामन्त्र्य पाण्डवांश्च महर्षयः॥
en: Having obtained the leave of Bhishma and of the Pandava princes those Rishis then disappeared before the very sight of all the beholders.

sa: लक्ष्मणो राजपुत्रश्च धृष्टद्युम्नस्य चात्मजाः। शिखण्डिपुत्राः सर्वे च धृष्टकेतुश्च सानुजः॥
en: There were prince Lakshamana, and the son of Dhristadyumna, and all the children of Sikhandin, and Dhrishtaketu with his younger brother. were son

sa: संख्यामतिगुणां चापि तेषु लोकेषु मोदते। यस्तु संवत्सरं क्षान्तो भुङ्क्तेऽहन्यष्टमे नरः॥ देवकार्यपरो नित्यं जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्। पौण्डरीकम्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: He who shows mercy to all and fasting for seven days eats on every eighth day for whole year, and, pouring libations every day on the sacred fire, worship the celestials, regularly, acquires the great merits of the Paundarika sacrifice. The car he rides is lotus-hued.

sa: सर्वभावानतिक्रम्य लघुमात्रः परिव्रजेत्। समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु स्थावरेषु चरेषु च॥
en: Rejecting all objects, content with a very little, one should move about (homeless), pursuing an equal conduct towards all creatures mobile and immobile.

sa: गान्धार्या चाभ्यनुज्ञाताः कृतपादाभिवादनाः॥ जनन्या समुमाघ्राता: परिष्वक्ताश्च ते नृपम्। चक्रुः प्रदक्षिणं सर्वे वत्सा इव निवारणे॥ पुनः पुनर्निरीक्षन्तः प्रचक्रुस्ते प्रदक्षिणम्।
en: They adored the feet of Gandhari and received her blessings also. Their mother Kunti then smelt their heads, and dismissed them. They then went round the king like calves, when prevented from sucking, their dams, Indeed, they repeatedly walked round him, loO king steadfastly at him.

sa: गौतम उवाच वैवस्वती संयमनी जनानां यत्रानृतं नोच्यते यत्र सत्यम्। यत्राबला बलिनं यातयन्ति तत्र त्वाहं हस्तिनं यातयिष्ये॥
en: Gautama said Men are restrained in the region of Yama. No falsehood can be told there. Only truth prevails in that place. There the weak persecute the strong. Going there I shall compel you to yield up this elephant to me.

sa: अकण्टकानां वृक्षाणां श्वेतप्रायाश्च वर्णतः। तेषां पुष्पाणि देवानामिष्टानि सततं प्रभो॥
en: The flowers of trees which have no thorns are generally white in colour. Such flowers are always acceptable to the celestials, O lord.

sa: राजानो ब्राह्मणा धर्मसेतवः। तस्माद् राजा द्विजातीनां प्रयतेत स्म रक्षणे॥
en: Kings are desirous of acquiring piety, and Brahmanas are causeways of Piety. Therefore, the king should always strive to protect the twice-born ones.

sa: स्वधां रजतपात्रेषु दुदुहुः पितरश्च ताम्। वत्सो वैवस्वतस्तेषां यमो दोग्धाऽन्तकस्तदा॥
en: The ancestral manes milked her of Svadhas in pots of silver. Vaivasvata became their calf and the Destroyer (Yama) himself became their milker.

sa: अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः। अनाशिनोऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद् युध्यस्व भारत॥
en: The (imaterial) body (only) of the everlasting, indestructible, infinite and embodied. Self is said to be perishable. Therefore, O Bharata, engage in battle.

sa: निवृत्तरोषे तस्मिंस्तु भगवत्यपराजिते। सा कन्यापि जगामाथ समीपात् तस्य धीमतः॥
en: When that invincible and illustrious divinity had cast his wrath off, that lady also went away from the presence of that intelligent being.

sa: श्वोभूते कत्थनावाक्यं विज्ञास्यति सुयोधनः। आचितं शरजालेन मया दृष्ट्वा पितामहम्॥
en: When the morrow comes Suyodhana will know what it is to boast of seeing the grandfather felled down by my shower of arrows.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुस्तथा चक्रे धनंजयः। व्यूह्य तानि बलान्याशु प्रययौ फाल्गुनस्तथा॥
en: Having said this, the mighty-armed Dhananjaya (Arjuna), did as he said. Phalguna (Arjuna) quickly placing his troops in battlearray, marched against the enemy.

sa: एवमेते महेष्वासास्तावकाः पाण्डवैः सह। समेत्य समरे शूरः सम्प्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: Thus the warriors of your army, all heroic and mighty bow-men, encountering the Pandavas in the battle, began to smite one another down.

sa: देवा देवर्षयश्चैव गन्धर्वाश्च सहोरगैः। विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्दृष्ट्वा कृष्णो तथागतौ॥
en: The celestial, the divine divine sages, the Gandharvas, and the mighty reptiles, were all overwhelmed with amazement beholding Krishna and Arjuna thus situated.

sa: तव संधारयन् पुत्रमब्रवीच्छान्तनोः सुतः। दुर्योधन विजानीहि स्थिरो भूत्वा विशाम्पते॥
en: Spoke these words to your son, consoling him therewith "O Duryodhana, O ruler of men, hear patiently what I now speak to you.

sa: विधाय रक्षां भीष्माय समाभाष्य परस्परम्। अनुमान्य च गाङ्गेयं कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्॥ क्रोधसंरक्तनयनाः समवेत्य परस्परम्। पुनर्युद्धाय निर्जग्मुः क्षत्रियाः कालचोदिताः॥
en: Having arranged for Bhishma's safety and having greeted one another, and with the permission of the son of Ganga and having circumambulated him and looking at each other with eyes coppery with anger, those Kshatriyas, goaded by Destiny, again issued forth for fighting with one another.

sa: भूरिश्रवा रणे राजन् याज्ञसेनं महारथम्। महता सायकौघेन छादयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: Bhurisrava endued with great prowess, O king, covered in battle with a great stream of arrows, the mighty car-warrior, the son of Yajnasena.

sa: तत्रैव धर्मराजोऽपि गजानीकेन संवृतः॥ ततस्तु सात्यकी राजन् द्रौपद्याः पञ्चचात्मजाः।
en: Dharmaraja Yudhishthira was also there surrounded by his innumerable elephants. Next to them, O king, stood Satyaki and the five sons of Draupadi.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु समरे दंशितो रथमास्थितः। व्यराजत श्रिया जुष्टो यथा शक्रस्त्रिविष्टपे॥
en: Duryodhana also that battlefield, occupying his car and clad in mail, and endued with all grace, looked beautiful like Indra himself in paradise.

sa: संजय उवाच गतपूर्वाह्नभूयिष्ठे तस्मिन्नहनि भारत। रथनागाश्वपत्तीनां सादिनां च महाक्षये॥
en: Sanjaya said O descendant of Bharata when that day passed away, when the destruction of car, elephants, horses, foot-soldiers and horsemen went apace.

sa: स संनद्धो महाबाहुराचार्येण महात्मना। रथानां च सहस्रेण त्रिगर्तानां प्रहारिणाम्॥
en: Then the mighty-armed king, accoutered by the illustrious preceptor, supported by a thousand car-warriors of the Trigartta country, all accomplished in smiting down.

sa: मण्डलं सर्वतः श्लिष्टं रथिनामुग्रधन्विनाम्॥ किरतां शरवर्षाणि स नागः पर्यवर्तत।
en: Then mounted on his elephant, he remained inside that compact circle of fierce bow-men riding on chariots and pouring showers of arrows. a

sa: तांस्तु सर्वान् महेष्वासान् सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। जघान परमेष्वासो दिव्येनास्त्रेण वीर्यवान्।॥
en: Then Satyaki of infallible prowess endued with great strength that mighty bow man slew all those excellent bowmen with weapons of celestial make.

sa: ध्मायत्सु दधिवर्णेषु जलजेषु समन्ततः। शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य निर्याताः पाण्डवा युधि॥
en: And with the blare of conchs of the hue of curds, all around, placing Shikhandin at their van, marched forth in battle array.

sa: चित्रसेनो महाराज चेकितानं समभ्ययात्॥ भीष्मप्रेप्सुं रणे यान्तं वृषं व्याघ्रशिशुर्यथा।
en: Chitrasena, O king, confronted in battle Chekitana who had been proceeding against Bhishma in battle like a tiger cub rushing against a bull.

sa: शल्यस्तु नकुलं वीर: स्वस्त्रीयं प्रियमात्मनः। विव्याध प्रहसन् बाणैालयन् कोपयन्निव॥
en: The heroic Shalya, pierced, smilingly, his own dear nephew Nakula, as if in dalliance, with arrows, in order to excite the latter's Wrath.

sa: न हि मद्राधिपादन्यः सर्वराजसु भारत। सोढुमुत्सहते वेगं भीमसेनस्य संयुगे॥
en: Bharata, none among host of kings, except the ruler of the Madras, could withstand in battle, the impetuosity of the attack of Bhimasena.

sa: केकया भ्रातरः पञ्च गान्धारान् पञ्च मारिष। ससैन्यास्ते ससैन्यांश्च योधयामासुराहवे॥
en: O respected one, the Kaikeya brothers at the head of their troops attacked in that battle the five Gandharva princes with their troops.

sa: उत्तमं जवमास्थाय प्रययुर्यत्र सोऽभवत्। तान् प्रयातान् समालोक्य युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः॥ पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सार्धं पृष्ठतोऽनुययुः परान्। तान्यनकान्यथालोक्य राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Proceeded in all have to the spot where the later was. Beholding them advance, the Panchalas together with the Pandavas headed by Yudhishthira himself pursued the enemy from behind. Beholding that mighty host, the foremost of the Rakshasa endued with prowess.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा कौरव्यस्य महात्मनः। नाराजं प्रेषयामास क्रुद्ध आशीविषोपमम्॥
en: Thereat king Yudhishthira inflamed with rage, sped at that high-souled grandsire of the Kurus, a Naracha that resembled a snake of virulent venom.

sa: स सौमदत्तेस्त्वरितश्चित्रेष्वसनकेतने। पुनः पताकां सूतं च छत्रं चापातयद् रथात्॥
en: The son of Somadatta then with great activity, cut-off the latter's bowstring, banner, charioteer, umbrella and flag-staff and felled him from his car.

sa: क्रुद्धं तमुवीक्ष्य भयेन राजन् सम्मूर्च्छितो न लभे शान्तिमद्य। इच्छे प्रसादात् तव सत्यसंध प्राप्तुं जयं पाण्डवेयांश्च हन्तुम्॥
en: Beholding Bhima, I have been, O sire, unmanned with fear, even now I can not regain the equilibrium of my mind, O you of neverfalling aim, I desire, through your grace, to obtain victory and to slay the sons of Pandava”.

sa: ततस्तत् कथयामास यथा दृष्टं धनंजयः। आश्वासनार्थं सुहृदां त्र्यम्बकेण समागमम्॥
en: Then, for giving very assurance to his partisans, Dhananjaya related everything he had seen in his dream-his meeting with the three eyed god.

sa: व्यास उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। अकम्पनस्य कथितं नारदेन पुरा नृप॥
en: Vyasa said On this subject, O monarch, an ancient story is cited as an example, story that was related to Akampana by Narada.

sa: तस्य ज्यातलघोषेण क्षत्रियान् भयमाविशत्। परांस्तु तव सैन्यस्य हर्षः परमकोऽभवत्॥
en: The twang of his bow-string inspired the hostile warriors with fear, filling at the same time, the hearts of your troops with joy.

sa: अन्योन्यं च शरैः क्रुद्धौ ततक्षाते परस्परम्। मानिनं समरे दृप्तं कृतवैरं महारथम्॥ भीमसेनस्तव सुतं दुर्योधनमयोधयत्। तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ कुरुमुख्यौ महाबलौ॥
en: Those (two) chastisers of foes fought on and weakened each other with sharp arrows. Bhimasena fought with your son Duryodhana, that great car-warrior who had injured (the Pandavas) in pride. Both of those Kuru chiefs are foremost of men and both of them are great car-warriors.

sa: ततो भीष्मो महाबाहुः पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। सेनां जघान संक्रुद्धो दिव्यैरस्त्रैर्महाबलः॥
en: Then the mighty armed Bhishma endued with great strength waxing worth began to slay with weapons of celestial mace, the Pandavas of high-soul.

sa: युयुत्सुं पाण्डवार्थाय यतमानं महारथम्। सुबाहु रतं शूरं यत्तो द्रोणादवारयत्॥
en: With all his endeavours, Subahu kept away from Drona, his brother, the mighty and heroic car-warrior Yuyutsu, who was fighting for the Pandavas.

sa: राजानां पाण्डवश्रेष्ठं धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम्। वेलेव सागर क्षुब्धं मद्रराट् समवारयत्॥
en: The ruler of the Madras, resisted king Yudhishthira of righteous soul, that foremost of the Pandavas, like the banks resisting the agitated ocean.

sa: द्वितीयं चापरं नाग सहस्रशिरसं वरम्। मन्तं विपुला ज्वाला ददृशातेऽग्निवर्चसम्॥
en: They also saw there another foremost of snakes possessing a thousands hoods, of the effulgence of fire; it was then vomiting terrible flames.

sa: नैष शक्यो मया वीरः संख्यातुं रथसत्तमः। निर्दहेदपि लोकांस्त्रीनिच्छन्नेष महारथः॥
en: This best among the Rathas, this hero cannot be described by me; if this Maharatha wishes he can burn up the three worlds.

sa: सुदर्शनं प्रवक्ष्यामि द्वीपं तु कुरुनन्दन। परिमण्डलो महाराज द्वीपोऽसौ चक्रसंस्थितः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, I shall now describe to you the island called Sudarshana. O king, this island is circular like a wheel.

sa: तस्य द्रोणः पुनश्चापं चिच्छेदामित्रकर्शनः। हयांश्चचतुरस्तूर्णं चतुर्भिः सायकोत्तमैः॥ वैवस्वतक्षयं घोरं प्रेषयामास भारत। सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then again Drona, that grinder of foes, cut down Dhrishtadyumna's bow; and his four steeds he dispatched to the dreadful abode of Death with four excellent arrows; and. O Bharata, Drona also dispatched to Death Dhrishtadyumna's charioteer with a broadheaded shaft.

sa: ततो व्यूढान्यनीकानि तव तेषां च भारत। शनैरुपेयुरुयोन्यं योध्यमानानि संयुगे॥
en: Thereafter, O Bharata, your, as well their, divisions were formed into battle-array; and slowly then advanced desirous of encountering one another in battle.

sa: स तालकेतोस्तीक्ष्णेन केतुमाहत्य पत्रिणा। भीष्मेण युयुधे वीरस्तस्य चानुरथैः सह॥
en: Striking with a sharp arrows the palmyra standard (of Bhishma) that hero fought with Bhishma and those others warriors who were protecting him.

sa: राष्ट्रनिर्वासनक्लेशं वनवासं च पाण्डव। कृष्णायाश्च परिक्लेशं संस्मरन् पुरुषो भव॥
en: Remembering therefore the trouble of being exiled from the kingdom, the residence in the forest and the sufferings of Krishna, be a man.

sa: अयुञ्जमेव चैवाहं तदस्त्रं भृगुनन्दने। प्रस्वापं मां प्रयुञ्जानं नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: But for all that I still aimed that weapon at the descendant of Bhrigu. As I was aiming it, Narada addressed me, saying

sa: तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने संकुले तुमुले भृशम्। उभयोरपि संशान्ता हयसङ्घाः समन्ततः॥
en: When that general and dreadful encounter regard fiercely, the chargers of the two hosts, seized with panic, coursed wildly all over the field.

sa: ततो जित्वा त्वमेवैनं पुनरुत्थापयिष्यसि। अस्त्रेण दयितेनाजो भीष्म सम्बोधनेन वै॥
en: Having thus vanquished him, you yourself will raise him up again to the battle-field by that dear weapon, O Bhishma, known as Samabodhana.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तयोस्तस्य च भारत॥ विराटो दशभिर्भल्लैराजघान परंतप।
en: Then, O Bharata, a dreadful fight ensued between him and the old heroes. ( afflicter of foes, with ten broad-headed shafts Virata wondered.

sa: तथैव लक्ष्मणो राजन् सौभद्रं निशितैः शरैः। अविध्यत महाराज तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: So also, O king, Lakshmana pierced the son of Subhadra with sharp arrows; and O mighty sovereign, the feat seemed to be marvelous.

sa: एवमेतं महाव्यूह व्यूह्य भारत पाण्डवाः। समुच्छ्रितैर्ध्वजैश्छत्रैः शस्त्रैश्च विमलैः शितैः॥
en: Thus 0 Bharata, disposing their troops in this array, the Pandavas, O mighty monarch, donning their mails and desirous of battle at sunrise.

sa: तेनान्तरेण बीभत्सुविंवेशामित्रबाहिनीम्। न लेभाते तु तौ द्वारं वारितौ कृतवर्मणा॥
en: Meanwhile Arjuna had gone into the array of the hostile troops. But his two wheelprotectors held in check by Kritavarman, obtained no admission.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महेष्वासः सप्तभल्लैः सुतेजनैः। धनूंषि तेषामाच्छिद्य ममर्द पृतनापतिः॥
en: The great bowman, that commander of the force, being greatly enraged at this struck their bows with seven broad-headed arrows of great impetuosity.

sa: सत्यजित् समरश्लाघी दुपदस्यात्मजो युवा। गतः सोऽतिरथत्वं हि धृष्टद्युम्नेन सम्मितः॥
en: The youthful son of Drupada, Satyajit, is proud of velour in battle, and being equal to Dhrishtadyumna should be included among the Atirathas.

sa: दिव्यमस्त्रं सुतस्तेऽयं येनावध्यो भविष्यति। नास्ति चाप्यमरत्वं वै मनुष्यस्य कथंचन॥
en: I give to your son a celestial weapon by virtue of which he will be unslayable. Men could never obtain immortality on earth.

sa: त्वामिहैकाकिनी दृष्ट्वा निर्जने गहने वने। प्रार्थयिष्यन्ति राजानस्तस्मान्मैवं मनः कृथाः॥
en: Seeing yourself alone in these dreary and solitary woods kings will court you; therefore do not set your heart on such a life.

sa: काञ्चनेषु तनुत्रेषु किरीटेषु ध्वजेषु च। शिलानामिव शैलेषु पतितानामभूद् ध्वनिः॥
en: The sound of the fall of armours, of crowns and diadems and of standards, resembled the sound of falling stones on hard founds.

sa: इमां ते तरुणी भार्यां तवाधिभिरभिप्लुताम्। कथं संधारयिष्यामि विवत्सामिव धेनुकाम्॥
en: How shall I comfort your young wife overwhelmed by the grief caused by your death and resembling a cow bereft of its calf.

sa: न विव्यथे महाराज पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। अथैनमब्रवीत् क्रुद्धः क्रूरः संरक्तलोचनः॥
en: Your son Duryodhana, O monarch, did not waver at all. Then Ghatotkacha with his eyes coppery in wrath thus addressed Duryodhana angrily saying

sa: दृष्ट्वा विशोकं समरे भीमसेनस्य सारथिम्। धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज दुर्मना गतचेतनः॥
en: Seeing, in that conflict, Vishoka the charioteer of Bhimasena, Dhrishtadyumna, O mighty monarch, became depressed in mind and was deprived of his senses.

sa: पाण्डवानां महासैन्यं यं दृष्ट्वोद्यतमाहवे। प्रावेपत भयोद्विग्नं सिंहं दृष्ट्वेव गोगणः॥
en: Seeing him ready for battle, the great army of the Pandavas trembled in fear like a herd of kine on seeing a lion.

sa: आसीत् परमको हर्षस्तावकानां विशाम्पते। इतरेषां तु वीराणां नेत्रेभ्यः प्रापतज्जलम्॥
en: Indeed, 0 king, your warriors transported with delight, while tears rolled were down from the eyes of the warriors of the other host.

sa: अभिदुतं परीप्सन्तः पुत्रं दुर्योधनं तव। तदनीकमनाधृष्यं पालितं तु महारथैः॥ आततायिनमायान्तं प्रेक्ष्य राक्षससत्तमः। नाकम्पत महाबाहुर्मैनाक इव पर्वतः॥
en: Proceeded, desirous of rescuing your son Duryodhana who had been hotly pressed. Beholding that invincible division protected by many mighty car-warriors make towards himself with hostile intentions, that foremost of Rakshasas possessed of mighty arms, remained immovable like the Mountain Mainaka,

sa: धनुषां कूजतां शब्दः सर्वतस्तुमुलो रणे। अश्रूयत महाराज वंशानां दह्यतामिव॥
en: On all sides of the field of battle, the twanging of bows was heard, O mighty monarch, like the crackling of burning bamboo's.

sa: उत्पतद्भिश्च तैस्तत्र समुद्भूतं महद् रजः। दिवाकररथं प्राप्य छादयामास भास्करम्॥
en: As these rushed to the charge, there arose a thick cloud of dust, that mounting to the solar orbit shrouded the sun itself.

sa: पौरवो धृष्टकेतुं तु शङ्खदेशे महासिना। ताडयामास संक्रुद्धस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Then the wrathful descendant of Puru, with his huge sword, struck Dhrishtaketu on the frontal bone, saying at the same time 'Stop, stop.'

sa: यथाप्रतिज्ञं कौरव्यः स चापि समितिंजयः। पार्थानामकरोद् भीष्मः सततं समितिक्षयम्॥
en: That conqueror of assembled enemies, viz., Bhishma, that foremost of Kuru heroes ever redeeming his vows, also destroyed the hosts of the Pandavas.

sa: तस्मात् कुबेरो भगवांश्चतुर्थं भागमश्नुते। ततः कलांशं वित्तस्य मनुष्येभ्यः प्रयच्छति॥
en: A fourth part of them is enjoyed by Kubera. Only a sixteenth part he gives away to men to be enjoyed by them.

sa: द्रौपदेयाऽभिमन्युश्च शिखण्डी चापराजितः। न प्राजहन् भीमसेनं भये जाते महाबलम्॥
en: And the sons of Draupadi, and Abhimanyu and the ever-victorious Shikhandin, these mighty warriors did not forsake Bhimasena, as they all apprehended danger.

sa: तत् प्रविश्य शिखण्डी सा दुपदस्यात्मजा नृप। अनश्नाना बहुतिथं शरीरमुदशोषयत्॥
en: Entering it, the daughter of king Drupada Shikhandin, O king, began to reduce her body by remaining without food for many a day.

sa: न्यायेनाधिगतं वित्तं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ह्यमन्यत। वेदानधीत्य धर्मेण यश्चके द्विषतो वशे॥
en: He gave away unto the Brahmanas his wealth acquired through fair means. Having studied the Vedas he subdued his foes in fair combats.

sa: वासुदेवमयः सोऽहं त्वयैवास्मि विनिर्मितः। विभज्य भागशोऽऽत्मानं व्रज मानुषतां विभो॥
en: Thus created by the essence of Vamdeva. I have been created by yourself Dividing yourself into portions, O Lord create yourself among humanity.

sa: प्रतिज्ञातो हि भवता दुःखप्रतिशमो मम। भवेयं पुरुषो यक्ष त्वत्प्रसादादनिन्दितः॥
en: The pacification of my grief has been promised by you. Let me become a man, O Yaksha, through your grace, O faultless one.

sa: दृढाहतस्ततो भीमो भारद्वाजस्य संयुगे। सारथिं प्रेषयामास यमस्य सदनं प्रति॥
en: Thus wounded sore in that battle by the son of Bharadvaja, Bhima dispatched the latter's charioteer to the regions of the of Death.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धा महेष्वासो दुःशासनमभाषत॥ एष पार्थो रणे क्रुद्धः पाण्डवानां महारथः।
en: That mighty bowman thus deeply pierced addressing Dushasana said: 'This mighty carwarriot of the Pandava host, viz., Pritha's son Arjuna, inflamed with rage,

sa: स्वेषां चैव परेषां च समदृश्यन्त भारत। महेन्द्रकेतवः शुभ्रा महेन्द्रसदनेष्विव॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, these standards on your side and those on their side resembled the banners of Indra in his celestial mansions.

sa: आर्तनादं रणे चक्रुर्गर्जन्तो जलदा इव। बहुधा दारितश्चैव विषाणैस्तत्र दन्तिभिः॥
en: Began to utter distressful shrieks like masses of roaring clouds. Mangled with the tusks of those elephant in many parts of his body,

sa: सेनयोरुभयोश्चापि गाङ्गेये निहते विभौ॥ संन्यस्य वीराः शस्त्राणि प्राध्यायन्त समन्ततः।
en: On the fall of that illustrious son of Ganga, the heroic combatants of the two armies laying down their weapons, fell to thinking.

sa: अन्नाद् भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः। यज्ञाद् भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः॥
en: Creatures are the out-come of food. Food is produced by rain. The rain is produced by Sacrifice. The Sacrifice is produced by action.

sa: परिववू रणे यत्ता भीमसेनं समन्ततः। गजमध्यमनुप्राप्तः पाण्डवः स व्यराजत॥
en: Surrounded him on all sides with great carefulness. Then that son of Pandu, standing in the midst of that elephant division, appeared beautiful,

sa: तथा हया हयारोहैस्ताडिताः प्रासतोमरैः। तेन तेनाभ्यवर्तन्त कुर्वन्तो व्याकुला दिशः॥
en: So also horses pierced with lances and dares by cavalry-soldiers, dashed against their assailants, as if agitating all the points of the compass.

sa: स तेनाभिहत: संख्ये भीष्मः कुरुपितामहः॥ नाकम्पत महाराज क्षितिकम्पे यथाचलः।
en: Then, O mighty monarch, Shikhandin inflamed with wrath struck the grandsire of the Bharatas on the breast with nine shafts of great sharpness.

sa: रथिनो रथिभिः सार्धं कुलपुत्रास्तनुत्यजः। परां शक्तिं समास्थाय चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत्॥
en: Car-warriors born in noble families, and reckless of their lives, meeting their hostile compeers, fought on dauntlessly depending on their own excellent strength.

sa: शिखण्डी तु महाराज भरताना पितामहम्॥ आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः।
en: Then, O mighty monarch, Shikhaindin inflamed with wrath struck the grandsire of the Bharatas on the breast with nine shafts of great sharpness.

sa: यदि साध्याश्च रुद्राश्च वसवश्च सहाश्विनः। मरुतश्च सहेन्द्रेण विश्वेदेवाः सहेश्वराः॥
en: Even if the Saddhyas, the Rudras, the Vasus together with the twin Aswins, the Marutas with Indra, the Visvadevas and the mighty gods.

sa: तत्र नागसहस्राणि हयानामयुतानि च। तथा रथसहस्राणि पदातीनां च भारत॥
en: And in that part (were) thousands of elephants, and ten thousands of steeds, as well as thousands of cars and foot-soldiers O Bharata.

sa: अर्जुनस्य सुतं त्वेष शिष्यत्वादभिरक्षति। शिष्याः पुत्राश्च दयितास्तदपत्यं च धर्मिणाम्॥
en: He spares the son of Arjuna for he is his pupil. Pupils, their sons and grandsons, are ever dear to the righteous people.

sa: स तु बाणैः शितैस्तूर्णं प्रत्यविध्यत मारिष। पश्यतां धार्तराष्ट्राणामश्वत्थामानमा निः॥
en: son Thereupon O Sire, Arjuna's son pierced Ashvatthaman in return with whetted shafts, before the presence of all the warriors of your army.

sa: तमार्तमभिसंप्रेक्ष्य राजा किल स सैन्धवः। मृदु चात्महितं चैव साक्षेपमिदमुक्तवान्॥
en: Then the ruler of the Shindhus seeing Duryodhana sorely afflicted, softly spoke these words, intended to conduce to his own welfare and good.

sa: गजानीकेन सहितस्तेन राजा सुयोधनः। मागधं पुरतः कृत्वा भीमसेनं समभ्ययात्॥
en: King Suyodhana then accompanied by that division of elephants, and placing the ruler of the Maghadas in front of him, advanced towards Bhimasena.

sa: अत्यन्तवैरिणं दृप्तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रु पराजितम्। धर्ममारुतशक्राणामश्विनोः प्रतिमास्तथा॥ धारयन्तो ध्वजाग्रेषु द्रौपदेया महारथाः। सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डिनौ॥ केकया धृष्टकेतुश्च मत्स्याः पञ्चालसंजयाः। पाण्डवाश्च मुदा युक्ता युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः॥ अभ्यद्रवन्त त्वरिता द्रोणानीकं बिभित्सवः।
en: The five mighty car-warriors, viz., the five sons of Draupadi bearing on their standards as device the images of Yama, Maruta, Indra and the Asuras, as also Satyaki, Chekitana, Dhrishtadyumna Sikhandin, the Kekaya brothers, Dhristaketu and the Matsyas, the Panchalas and the Srinjayas and the Pandavas, were all enraptured and then headed by Yudhishthira, they rushed to battle desirous of breaking through Drona's division.

sa: पराक्रमं ततस्तस्य पराक्रम्य पराक्रमी॥ तरसा वारयामास मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्।
en: The brave one (Bhishma) then put forth his prowess; he quickly checked his adversary's valour as a mad elephants checks another inad elephant.

sa: ततः प्रविष्यथे सेना पाण्डवी भृशमाकुला। आचार्यपुत्रेण हते नीले ज्वलिततेजसि॥
en: After Nila of furious energy had been thus slain by the preceptor's son, the host of the Pandavas, was greatly agitated with grief.

sa: ततस्तु कृष्णः समरे दृष्ट्वा भीष्मपराक्रमम्। सम्प्रेक्ष्य च महाबाहुः पार्थस्य मृदुयुद्धताम्॥ भीष्मं च शरवर्षाणि सृजन्तमनिशं युधि। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं मध्यमासाद्य सेनयोः॥
en: Then seeing the great prowess of Bhishma and the mildness with which Arjuna fought, and also seeing that Bhishma was showering a continuous shower of arrows in that battle and that he was appearing like the all consuming sun in the midst of the two arinies.

sa: तमुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा कैलासमिव शृङ्गिणम्। भीमसेनं महाबाहुं पुत्रास्ते प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Seeing that mighty armed Bhimsena with uplifted mace look like the Kailasa mount towering with its peaks your sons fled out of terror.

sa: युध्यध्वं मा पलायध्वं मायैषा राक्षसी रणे। घटोत्कचप्रमुक्तेति नातिष्ठन्त विमोहिताः॥
en: scene "Go on fighting, fly not, this illusion has been set forth by Ghatotkacha?" But confounded as they were, they did not stop;

sa: भीमधन्वायनी सेना धृष्टद्युम्नेन पालिता। गड्डेच पूर्णा स्तिमिता स्यन्दमाना व्यदृश्यत॥
en: Then that army, of terrible archers commanded by Dhrishtadyumna, as it moved to and fro, looked like the full Ganga, silently rushing on.

sa: प्रत्युद्गम्याथ विव्याध सात्यकिस्तं शितैः शरैः। पाण्डवप्रियकामार्थं शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Rushing against him like a tiger rushing against an elephant, Satyaki pierced him with whetted shafts, desirous of doing good to the Pandavas.

sa: दिदेश तान्यनीकानि प्रयाणाय महीपतिः। तेषां युधिष्ठिरो राजा ससैन्यानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: The ruler of the earth, ordered those forces to advance. And king Yudhishthira ordered for those high-souled (warriors) with forces, consisting of infantry.

sa: शारद्वतस्ततो राजन् भीष्मस्य प्रमुखे स्थितम्। अर्जुनं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकानां समाचिनोत्॥
en: Then, O king, The son of Sharadvata, who was stationed in front of Bhishma, pierced Arjuna with a number of twenty five arrows.

sa: स्त्रियो वृद्धास्तथा बालाः प्रेक्षकाच पृथग्जनाः। समभ्ययुः शान्तनवं भूतानीव तमोनुदम्॥
en: Women, old and children, and numerous other, spectators approached the son of Shantanu, like the Bhutas approaching the iising .luminary of the day.

sa: श्वानः काकाश्च गृध्राश्च वृका गोमायुभिः सह। प्रणेदुर्भक्ष्यमासाद्य विकृताश्च मृगद्विजाः॥
en: Dogs, crows, vultures, wolves, and jackels and other beasts set up loud yields, at the sight of food that was then before them.

sa: तौ समेत्यार्जुनं वीरौ पुरु पश्चाच्च धन्विनौ। अविध्येतां महावेगैर्निशितैराशुगै शम्॥
en: Those two heroic bowmen assailing Arjuna simultaneously from the rear and the van, began to pierce him with swift-flying arrows coursing with vehemence.

sa: एको भीमः परं शक्त्या युध्यत्येव महाभुजः। केवलं बाहुवीर्येण क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्॥
en: The greatly powerful Bhishma alone, remembering Kshatriya duties, fights with all the prowess of his arms and to the utmost of his Power.

sa: द्वाभ्यामेव तु मासाभ्यां कृपः शारद्वतोऽब्रवीत्। द्रौणिस्तु दशरात्रेण प्रतिजज्ञे बलक्षयम्॥
en: Then Sharadvata's son, Kripa replied “In two month's time." And the son of Drona promised the destruction of the army in ten nights.

sa: हप्तानां धार्तराष्ट्राणां सिंहनादो मया श्रुतः॥ युयुत्सुश्चापि कृष्णेन श्रुतो वीरानुपालभन्।
en: I heard indeed the war-cries of the Dhritarashtras, elated with pride and Krishna also heard Yuyutsu admonishing the heroes in the following terms.

sa: संरक्ष्यमाणां तां दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवैर्वाहिनीं रणे। व्यावृत्य चक्षुषी कोपाद् भारद्वाजोऽन्ववैक्षत॥
en: Seeing the Pandavas protect their army in battle, the son of Bharadvaja, rolling his eyes in anger, cast his glances (on the army).

sa: पुत्रेषु तव वीरेषु चिक्रीडार्जुनपूर्वजः। मृगेष्विव महाराज चरन् व्याघ्रो महाबलः॥
en: Then the elder brother of Arjuna played amidst your heroic sons like, O monarch, a powerful tiger roving amidst a herd of deer.

sa: स बाणवर्ष सुमहदसृजत् पार्षतं प्रति॥ मघवान् समभिक्रुद्धः सहसा दानवानिव।
en: Then towards the son of Prishata he directed a close shower of arrows, like Meghavat exceedingly enraged shooting his shafts towards the Danavas.

sa: सौमराजमुपेत्याहमवोचं दुर्वचं वचः। न च मां प्रत्यगृह्णात् स चारित्र्यपरिशङ्कितः॥
en: Approaching then the king of Saubha I addressed him in improper words, but he did not accept me being suspicious of my character.

sa: विद्राव्य सर्वसैन्यानि तावकानि नरोत्तम। अभिमन्युः स्थितो राजन् विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: Thus counting all your troop. O foremost of men, Abhimanyu stood, O king, like a blazing fire with not a streak of smoke.

sa: निन्दामि भृशमात्मानं धिगस्तु क्षत्रजीविकाम्। अशक्तमिति मामेते ज्ञास्यन्ते क्षत्रिया रणे।॥
en: I can not but reproach myself. Fie on the life of a Kshatriya. These Kshatriyas may consider me incapable of batting any longer,

sa: ये लोका मातृहतॄणां ये चापि पितृघातिनाम्। गुरुदारगतानां ये पिशुनानां च ये सदा॥ साधूनसूयतां ये च ये चापि परिवादिनाम्। ये च निक्षेपहर्तृणां ये च विश्वासघातिनाम्॥ भुक्तपूर्वां स्त्रियं ये च विन्दतामघशंसिनाम्। ब्रह्मघ्नानां च ये लोका ये च गोघातिनामपि॥ पायसं वा यवान्नं वा शाकं कृसरमेव वा। संयावापूपमांसानि ये च लोका वृथाश्नताम्॥
en: Those regions which are allotted to those who ravish their own mothers, to those who slay their fathers, who violate their preceptor's beds and who are malicious; those regions which are reserved for those who harbour hatred against the righteous, who speak maliciously of others, who appropriate the wealth entrusted with them and who betray their trusts; those regions that are for them who abuse others' wives enjoyed by them before or for them that slay Brahmanas or for them that slaughter the kine or for them that drink payasas or eat food prepared from barley or herbs or articles prepared from milk, sesamum and rice and Pupas and other kinds of cakes or meat, without having first offered them to the gods.

sa: बहवश्च महाराज तस्य नादेन भीषिताः। प्रियान् प्राणान् परित्यज्य निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: Many were they, O king, who terrified at his roars, fell down on the surface of he carth giving up their dear lives.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य पुत्रांस्तव जनेश्वर। प्रजज्वाल रणे क्रुद्धो हविषा हव्यवाडिव॥
en: Bhimasena beholding your sons, O ruler of me, in battle, blazed forth in anger like the sacrificial fire blazing forth with clarified butter.

sa: पुनश्च निशितैर्बाणैः पार्थे विव्याध पञ्चभिः। तं पार्थो नवभिर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Then again with another five whetted arrows he pierced Pritha's son deeply. Then Partha also with nine arrows struck him between the breasts.

sa: ततोऽभिवाद्य चरणौ रामस्य शिरसा शुभौ। स्पृष्ट्वा पद्मदलामाभ्यां पाणिभ्यामग्रतः स्थिता॥
en: Saluting the holy feet of Rama with her head she touched them with her lotus like hands and stood in front of him.

sa: तान् भीमसेनः संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। द्रौपदेयाऽभिमन्युश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥
en: Threat Bhimsena, excited with rage, and Dhrishtadyumna of Prishata's race, the sons of Draupadi and Abhimanyu, the twin sons of Pandu by Madri.

sa: ततः सायकवर्षेण पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्। परानवाकिरत् पार्थः पर्वतानिव नीरदः॥
en: Then, like masses of clouds surcharged with rain drenching the mountain-breast with their contents. Pritha's son covered his enemies with his arrowy downpour.

sa: एतांश्च वचसा साम्ना समाश्वासय मानद। विदितं वेदितव्यं ते न शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: "O bestower of honour, do you console them with comforting speech. Everything worthy of being know is known to you. It behoves you not to indulge in grief.”

sa: संजय उवाच एवमाश्वासितो राजन् पुत्रेण तव सैन्धवः। दुर्योधनेन सहितो द्रोण रात्रावुपागमत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus comforted by your son Duryodhana, the ruler of the Sindhus, o king accompanied by the former, went that very night, to the camp of Drona.

sa: चेदिराजं च विक्रान्तं राजसेनापति बली। अर्पा विवदमानं च जघान पशुवत् तदा॥
en: That puissant one, slaughtered, like a beast, the king of the Chedis, that powerful leader of kingly hosts, when the latter disputed with him about the (sacrificial) Arghya.

sa: पर्यायेण वयं सर्वे कालेन बलिना हताः। परलोकं गमिष्यामः स्वैः स्वैः कर्मभिरन्विताः॥
en: One after another, destroyed by the powerful God of Death, we shall go to the regions of the departed, carrying with us the fruits of our respective actions.

sa: निजघ्ने समरे क्रुन्द्रो हस्त्यश्वं चामितं बहु। र६िनोऽयात बद् राजन् रथेभ्यः पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Wrought up with rage, he slew in battle countless nuinber: of elephants and stecd:". then, O king, that foremost of me throv, ing many car-warriors from their cars,

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु सहसाऽऽयान्तं पाञ्चाल्यो गुरुमात्मनः। नाशंसत वधं वीरः पुत्राणां तव भारत॥
en: Then the prince of the Panchalas, the heroic of son of Prishata, beholding his own preceptor suddenly make towards himself, desisted from compassing the death of your sons.

sa: एवं द्वन्द्वशतान्यासन् रथवारणवाजिनाम्। पदातीनां च भद्रं ते तव तेषां च संकुले॥
en: Good betide you. Thus amidst that dreadful general engagements, hundreds of single combats were fought between the car-warriors, the elephant-warriors, horse-warriors and footsoldiers of your army and theirs.

sa: तस्माद्रवत मा योधाः फाल्गुनं प्राप्य संयुगे। अहमद्य रणे यत्तो योधयिष्यामि पाण्डवम्॥
en: Therefore, O warriors, do you not run away getting Phalguna as an adversary in battle. I myself, putting forth my best energies, shall day battle against the Pandavas,

sa: पितामह निबोधेदं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि भारत। नानुरूपमहं मन्ये त्वयि जीवति कौरव॥ द्रोणे चास्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठे सपुत्रे ससुहज्जने। कृपे चैव महेष्वासे द्रवते यद् वरूथिनी॥
en: “O grandfather, hear what I say; O descendant of Bharata, O scion of the Kuru race, when you, and that foremost of men learned in arms, Drona, with his son and with all our other friends, and also the great bowman Kripa are alive. I do not consider it creditable that my troops should run away.

sa: केन कालेन गाङ्गेय क्षपयेथा महाद्युते। आचार्यो वा महेष्वासः कृपो वा सुमहाबलः॥
en: By what time, O son of Ganga, of great effulgence, can you annihilate and (in what time) the mighty archer (our preceptor) Drona or Kripa, of great strength.

sa: क्षत्रियस्य तु धर्मोऽयं यद् युद्धं भृगुनन्दन। स्वाध्यायो व्रतचर्याऽथ ब्राह्मणानां परं धनम्॥
en: This is the duty of a Kshatriya, viz., to fight; O descendant of Bhrigu, study and the observance of religious austerities are the best wealth of the Brahmanas.

sa: सर्वथा भागधेयानि स्वानि प्राप्नोति मानवः। अनयस्यास्य तु मुखं भीष्मः शान्तनवो मम॥
en: In all circumstances does a man go through his share of worldly happiness and misery but Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, is the prime cause of this difficulty.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच इमे वै पृथिवीपाला: शेरते पृथिवीतले। निहताः पृतनामध्ये मृतसंज्ञा महाबलाः॥
en: Yudhishthira said These rulers of earth, all endued with great might, are now lying on the bare ground of the battle-field being slain and deprived of their senses.

sa: करिष्यामि हि ते कामं भागिनेय यथेप्सितम्। ब्रवीम्यतः क्लीबवत् त्वां युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि।।८३।
en: O nephew, it is for this I am speaking to you like a eunuch. I shall do as you desire. Battle excepted, what do you wise to get?

sa: यः प्राप्य राज्यं धर्मेण ऋत्विग्ब्रह्मपुरोहितान्। अपृच्छदात्मनः श्रेयः पृष्ट्वा तेषां मते स्थितः॥
en: Having obtained his kingdom by virtue, he used to question his Ritvigas, family priests and Brahmanas about its welfare and then used to live up to their instructions.

sa: अर्थस्य पुरुषो दासो दासस्त्वर्थो न कस्यचित्। इति सत्यं महाराज बद्धोऽस्म्यर्थन कौरवैः॥
en: A man is the slave of wealth, but wealth is the slave of none, O king, this is the truth. I am bound to the Kurus by wealth.

sa: पुण्यं यशस्यं स्वर्णं च धन्यमायुष्यमेव च। अस्येतिहासस्य सदा श्रवणं श्रावणं तथा॥
en: The frequent audition as well as the recital of this piece of history is held to be purifying, fame-giving leading to paradise, life-giving and fraught with all blessings.

sa: स तद् गृह्य धनुःश्रेष्ठं तस्थौ स्थानं समाहितः। विचकर्षाथ विधिवत् सशरं धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Then that Brahmacharin taking up that most excellent bow stood in the proper posture. And placing the arrow on the string he began to stretch the latter duly.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच कथं त्वामप्यतिक्रान्तः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। धनंजयो मया शक्य आचार्य प्रतिबाधितुम्॥
en: Duryodhana said O preceptor, how is it possible for me to hold in check that Dhananjaya who has passed even yourself, the foremost of all wielders of weapons?

sa: संजय उवाच अर्जुनस्तान् नरव्याघ्रः सुशर्मानुचरान् नृपान्। अनयत् प्रेतराजस्य सदनं सायकैः शितैः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then that foremost of of men Arjuna, conveyed, with his whetted shafts, the kings that followed Susharma to the abode of the lord of departed spirits.

sa: इह कीर्ति परे लोके दीर्घकालं महत् सुखम्। प्राप्स्यन्ति पुरुषव्याघ्राः प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा महाहवे॥
en: If these foremost of men abandon their lives in a great battle, they will acquire fame in this world and great and eternal happiness in the world ncxi.

sa: अन्योन्यं शरवर्षाभ्यां ववृषाते रणाजिरे। तौ वीक्ष्य तु महात्मानौ कृतिनौ चित्रयोधिनौ॥ विस्मयः सर्वभूतानां समपद्यत भारत। दुःशासनस्तु नकुलं प्रत्युद्याय महाबलम्॥ अविध्यन्निशितैर्बाणैहुभिर्मर्मदिभिः। तस्य माद्रीसुतः केतुं सशरं च शरासनम्॥ चिच्छेद निशितैर्बाणैः प्रहसन्निव भारत। अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समार्पयत्॥
en: They covered each other, on the field of battle, with showers of arrows. O descendant of Bharata, seeing the fight between these two illustrious and accomplished warrior learned in all the modes of warfare all creatures were filled with amazement. Dushasana rushed against the great car warrior Nakula and pierced him with many sharp arrows. The son of Madri laughingly cut off with his sharp arrows the standard and the bow of his adversary. He then wounded him with twenty five small headed arrows.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच किं कुर्वाणं रणे द्रोणं जनुः पाण्डवसुंजयाः। तथा निपुणमस्त्रेषु सर्वशस्त्रभृतामपि।।।।
en: What was Drona doing when the Pandavas and the Srinjayas slew him in battle,-he who was so skillful in the use of weapons amongst all wielders of arms?

sa: प्रतिपत्स्यति राजा स पिता ते यदनन्तरम्। तत्र वत्स्यसि कल्याणि सुखं सर्वगुणान्विता॥
en: The king, your father, will do what is proper for you and, O blessed lady, you will live there in happiness, endued with all accomplishments as you are.

sa: संजय उवाच नाशीर्यत धनुश्चास्य रथभङ्गो न चाप्यभूत्। युध्यमानस्य संग्रामे भीष्मस्य भारतर्षभ।५॥
en: Sanjaya said Neither was the bow of Bhishma broken nor was his car shattered to fragments, when, O foremost of the Bharata, he fought on with the foe,

sa: संजय उवाच पूर्वमस्मासु भग्नेषु फाल्गुनेनामितौजसा। द्रोणे च मोघसंकल्पे रक्षिते च युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: Sanjaya said Ourselves being at first broken and routed by Arjuna of immeasurable prowess and also the VOW of Drona being unfulfilled inconsequence of Yudhishthira being well guarded.

sa: शपेयं त्वां न चेदेवमागच्छेथा विशाम्पते। युध्यस्व त्वं रणे यत्तो धैर्यमालम्ब्य कौरव॥
en: If, O lord of the universe, you had not thus come to me I would have cursed you; fight you in battle with patience, O son of Kuru.

sa: शल्यं विव्याध सप्तत्या पुनश्च दशभिः शरैः॥ तं शल्यो नवभिर्भित्त्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः।
en: He pierced Shalya also first piercing him with seventy shafts and again with ten shafts. Shalya also first piercing him with nine arrows next wounded him with five.

sa: तं तु छित्त्वा रणे भीष्मो नाराचं कालसम्मितम्। निजने कौरवेन्द्रस्य हयान् काञ्चनभूषणान्॥
en: In that battle, Bhishma, having cut off that Naracha that resembled the Destroyer himself, slew the steeds caparisoned with golden ornaments, of that foremost of the Kurus (Yudhishthira).

sa: निमेषार्धेन की तेयं भीष्मः शान्तनवो युधि। अदृश्यं समरे चक्रे शरजालेन भागशः॥
en: In half a wink's time, Bhishma the son of Shantanu, in that battle made the son of Kunti disappear in battle, covering him with distinct sets of arrows.

sa: पृथु वैन्यं प्रजा दृष्ट्वा रक्ताः स्मेति यदब्रुवन्। ततो राजेति नामास्य अनुरागादजायत॥
en: Beholding Vena's son Prithu, his subjects said, “We are delighted and in consequence of the affection of his subjects which he enjoyed, he came to be called Raja.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच एवं व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु मामकेष्वितरेषु च। कथं प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठाः सम्प्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे॥श।
en: Dhritarashtra said When my troops and the troops of our foe were thus placed in battle array, how did then the foremost of warriors Bhishma begin to strike?

sa: कर्ण उवाच सर्व एव महात्मान इमे पुरुषसत्तमाः। सेनापतित्वमर्हन्ति नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥
en: Karna said All these foremost of men of high soul are worthy of the leadership (of this host). There is no necessity for making any selection. ever one

sa: अधस्ताद् धरणीं योऽसौ सदा धारयते नृप। शेषश्च पनगश्रेष्ठः स्वस्ति तुभ्यं प्रयच्छतु॥
en: And he who is underneath this earth and o king who ever upholds her, viz., Shesha, that foremost of snakes-may all these do what is beneficial to you!

sa: वृषकस्य हयान् सूतं धनुश्छत्रं रथं ध्वजम्। तिलशोव्यधमत् पार्थः सौबलस्य शितैः शरैः॥
en: Thereupon with whetted shafts, Pritha's son cut-off into fragments the steeds the charioteer, the bow, the standard, the umbrella and the chariot of Vrishaka the son of Subala.

sa: तस्य पापस्य करणात् फलं प्राप्नुहि दुर्मते। देहि युद्धं नरपते ममाद्य रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Receive, therefore, O wicked one, the (fruit) an account of the criminal act (of yours); give battle, O king, to me, on the field of battle, without delay.

sa: ते शराः प्राप्य कौन्तेयं समन्ताद् विविशुः प्रभो। फलभारनतं यद्वत् स्वादुवृक्षं विहङ्गमाः॥
en: Those arrows, reaching, the son of Kunti, entered into him, like, O lord, a flight of birds entering a tree bending with the burden of its tasteful fruits.

sa: स संवार्य रणे राजा प्रेषितान् धर्मसूनुना। शरान् सप्त महेष्वासः कौन्तेयाय समार्पयत्॥
en: That king, that mighty bowman, (Shrutayush) resisting in battle, the shafts, shot at him by the son of Pandu, sped at Kunti's son a group of seven arrows.

sa: योत्स्ये त्वया रणे राम सदृशेनाधिकेन वा। गुरुणा धर्मशीलेन जयमाशास्व मे विभो॥
en: Whether you are equal to me or superior I shall fight with you, my lord, though you are my virtuous preceptor. Bless me that I may obtain victory.

sa: वराह युधि जायन्ते क्षत्रियाः शूरसत्तमाः। त्रेतायां क्षत्रिया राजन् सर्वे वै चक्रवर्तिनः॥
en: In Treta age are born brave Kshatriyas who are subject to none who are long-lived, who are heroic, and who wield the bow in battle with great skill.

sa: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्बुवं जन्म मृतस्य च। तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि॥
en: For, death is certain to one who is born; and birth is certain to one who is dead. Therefore, for such unavoidable things, you ought not to grieve.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच पीड्यमानं बलं दृष्ट्वा पार्थैर्भीष्मः पराक्रमी। यदकार्षीद् रणे क्रुद्धस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Tell me, O Sanjaya, what did the mighty Bhishma wrought up with wrath do, when he saw my troops thus afflicted by the Partha's in battle?

sa: शमं चेद् याचमानं त्वं प्रत्याख्यास्यसि केशवम्। हिमार्थमभिजल्पन्तं न तवास्ति रणे जयः॥
en: And advises you for your welfare, victory will never fall in your lot in battle." Duryodhana however neglected him of the Dasharha race, that foremost of all bowmen.

sa: कर्मणो ह्यपि बौद्धव्य बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः। अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः॥
en: One must know what is action, one must also know what is forbidden action, and one must again know what is inaction. The nature of action is abstruse.

sa: बिडालोऽपि स दुष्टात्मा जगामैव यथागतम्॥ तथा त्वमपि दुष्टात्मन् न बैडालं व्रतमास्थितः।
en: The wicked-souled cat too went away where he came from. In the same way are you also, O you of wicked heart, adopting the policy of the cat.

sa: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः। मद्भक्त एतद् विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते॥
en: Thus in brief Kshetra, Knowledge, and the object of knowledge are declared to you. Knowing all this, O my friend and devotee, attain to yoga (assimilation with Me).

sa: नास्य युद्धे समं मन्ये कंचिदन्यं धनुर्धरम्। इच्छन् हन्यादिमां सेनां किमर्थमपि नेच्छति॥
en: I do not regard any other bowman equal to him in fight. If he wills, he can annihilate this vast host; but why does he not wish it?

sa: ते वयं प्रमुखे तस्य पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्। गाङ्गेयं पातयिष्याम उपायेनेति मे मतिः॥
en: Therefore, placing Shikhandin in front of him (Bhishma) and stationing him in our van, we shall, by this means, overthrow the son of Ganga. This is my opinion.

sa: अभिवादनदक्षं तं पितॄणां वचने रतम्॥ नाद्याहं यदि पश्यामि का शान्तिर्हृदयस्य मे।
en: Skillful in congratulating and welcoming others, obedient to the commands of his sires. If I do not see that son of mine, what peace can my heart enjoy?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं शान्तनवो भीष्मो दशमेऽहनि संजय। अयुध्यत महावीर्यः पाण्डवैः सहसृञ्जयैः॥ कुरवश्च कथं युद्धे पाण्डवान् प्रत्यवारयन्। आचक्ष्व मे महायुद्धं भीष्मस्याहवशोभिनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How, O Sanjaya, did the highly puissant son of Shantanu, viz., Bhishma fight on the tenth day with the Pandavas and the Srinjayas? How did also the Kurus, check the Pandavas in battle? Describe to me the fierce battle that Bhishma, that ornament of battlefield, fought with the foe.

sa: योत्स्यते समरे तात मायावी समरप्रियः। ये चास्य राक्षसा वीराः सचिवा वशवर्तिनः॥
en: The one who has powers of illusions, will fight, my dear son, in battle for he is fond of weapons. Those Rakshasas, too, who follow him, are heroes.

sa: सम्भाषित्वा च कर्णेन भ्रात्रा दुःशासनेन च। सौबलेन च राजेन्द्र मन्त्रयित्वा नरर्षभ।॥
en: And having consulted with Karna and also with his brother Duhshasana, and that best among men having also consulted with the son of Subala, O chief among kings!

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा निहतान् वीरो रणे पुत्रान् महाबलान्।॥ वार्ष्णेयो विनदन् राजन् भूरिश्रवसमभ्ययात्।
en: Beholding those mighty sons of his slain in battle, that hero of the Vrishni race namely Satyaki rushed against Bhurishravas, O king, thundering out of his war cry.

sa: स तद्गृहस्योपरि वर्तमान आलोकयामास धनाधिगोप्ता। स्थूणस्य यक्षस्य विवेश वेश्म स्वलंकृतं माल्यगुणैर्विचित्रैः॥
en: Moving to and fro over his abode, the protector of all wealth observed that the mansion of the Yaksha Sthuna was beautifully adorned with devise sorts of garlands;

sa: अर्थस्य पुरुषो दासो दासस्त्वर्थो न कस्यचित्। इति सत्यं महाराज बद्धोऽस्म्यर्थेन कौरवैः॥
en: A man is the slave of wealth, but wealth is the slave of none. O king, this is the truth. I am bound to the Kurus by wealth.

sa: अगाम समिति राज्ञां सैन्धवो विमृशन् बहु। स तेषां नरदेवानां सकाशे पर्यदेवयन्॥
en: Then that ruler of the Sindhus, having reflected for a long while, proceeded to the assembly of the kings; there, before the assemblage of monarchs, expressing his grief.

sa: तं हि दृष्ट्वा तथा विद्धं सौभद्रेण यशस्विना। सम्प्राद्रवच्चमूः सर्वा भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Beholding him thus deeply pierced by the illustrious son of Subhadra, all the troops began to fly away, even before the very eyes of the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: उलूक उवाच इदं त्वामब्रवीद् राजा धार्तराष्ट्रो महामनाः। शृण्वतां कुरुवीराणां तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Uluka said The royal son of Dhritarashtra, endued with a large mind, said this to you in the hearing, of the Kuru heroes; listen to them O Yudhishthira.

sa: स च्छाद्यमानो बहुधा पुत्रैस्तव विशाम्पते। क्किणी संलिहन् वीरः शार्दूल इव दर्पितः॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, when thus covered with arrows by your sons, that hero Bhima, agile as a tiger, began to lick the corners of his mouth.

sa: यस्य कोपान्महात्मानौ भीष्मद्रोणौ निपातितौ। प्राप्तः प्रकृतितो धर्मो न धर्मो मामकान् प्रति॥
en: Yudhishthira, through whose wrath Bhisma and Drona have met their ends. Righteousness had naturally attached itself to Yudhishthira, while it is hostile of the cause of my sons.

sa: तेषां व्यवसितं ज्ञात्वा भीमसेनो जिघृक्षताम्। समस्तानां वधे राजन् मतिं चक्रे महामनाः॥
en: And knowing the intention of those cousins of his who were all resolved to slay him, Bhimasena, possessed of great strength determined. O king, to slay them all.

sa: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः। तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः॥
en: To that Yogi, O Partha, I am easy of access who always meditate on Me, by withdrawing his mind from all other objects, and who constantly practices abstraction.

sa: वपूंषि च नरेन्द्राणां विगताभानि लक्षये। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु न च भ्राजन्ति दंशिताः॥
en: The persons of kings belonging to the host Dhritarashtra's son appear to have lost all splendor, and though clad in armour, they do not seem to be shining,

sa: एवंगते मयेदानी वैद्यैः कार्यमिहास्ति किम्॥ क्षत्रधर्मे प्रशस्तां हि प्राप्तोऽसस्मि परमां गतिम्।
en: Reduced to this condition, what necessity have I of physicians? I have attained to that blessed existence that is so applauded in those that observe the Kshatriya duties.

sa: येन देवारयः सर्वे मया युधि निपातिताः। तत आनीयतां कृष्णौ सशरं धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: With that bow and arrow, I slew in battle all the enemies of the gods. From that lake bring, O Krishnas, that excellent bow and arrow of mine.

sa: वृकोदरार्जुनौ यत्र वृष्णिवीरश्च सात्यकिः। उत्तमौजाश्च पाञ्चाल्यो युधामन्युश्च दुर्जयः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नश्च दुर्धर्षः शिखण्डी चापराजितः। अश्मकाः केकयाश्चैव क्षत्रधर्मा च सौमकिः॥ चैद्यश्च चेकितानश्च पुत्रः काश्यस्य चाभिभूः। द्रौपदेया विराटश्च दुपदश्च महारथः॥ यमो च पुरुषव्याघ्रौ मन्त्री च मधुसूदनः। क एताजातु युध्येत लोकेऽस्मिन् वै जिजीविषुः॥४२
en: There where remain Vrikodara and Arjuna and the Vrishni hero Satyaki and Uttamaujas of thie Panchala race and the indomitable Yudhamanyu and the invincible Dhristadyumna and the ever-victorious Sikhandin and the Ashmakas, Kekayas and Kshatradharinan of the Somaka clan, the ruler of the Chedis and Chekitana and Abhibhu the son of the Kasi king, the sons of Draupadi and Virata and the mighty car-warrior Drupada and those foremost of men the twins Nakula and Sahadeva and the slayer of Madhu as the counsellor. What man in this world desirous of living would venture to fight with these?

sa: यदि भीष्मः स्त्रियं हन्यात् सन्तः कुर्युर्विगर्हणम्। नैनं तस्माद्धनिष्यामि दृष्ट्वापि समरे स्थितम्॥
en: If Bhishma slays a woman, all rightminded men will censure him and therefore I will not slay him, even if I see him standing on the battle field.

sa: न माया हीन्द्रजालं वा कुहका वापि भीषणा। आत्तशस्त्रस्य संग्रामे वहन्ति प्रतिगर्जनाः॥
en: Neither deception, nor illusion, nor the trick of a conjurer is frightful to one who has taken up arms for fight, these only tend to excite his anger.

sa: प्रहरे क्षत्रधर्मस्य यं राम त्वं समाश्रितः। ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियत्वं हि याति शस्त्रसमुद्यमात्॥
en: I shall strike at your Kshatriya-hood since, O Rama, you have adopted the life of a Kshatriya; a Brahmana becomes a Kshatriya owing to his taking up arms.

sa: महाप्राज्ञो राजपुत्रो युयुत्सुः। कर्णोऽमात्यः कुशली तात कच्चित् सुयोधनो यस्य मन्दो विधेयः॥
en: Is the very wise prince Yuyutsu, the son of (Dhritarashtra by) the Vaishya lady in health? Is the minister Karna in health whose advice the dull-headed Suyodhana follows?

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठः प्रादात् कन्यां महीपतेः। विधिपूर्वां च तां राजा कन्यां प्रतिगृहीतवान्॥
en: The foremost among the twice born, saying, be it so, gave that damsel to the ruler of earth and the king too accepted that girl after suitable ceremonies.

sa: ये त्वेनपभिजानन्ति वृत्तेनाभिजनेन वा। तेषु साधुषु वस्तव्यं स वासः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते॥
en: It is said to be the best place to live where high birth and good conduct are known and respected and where men know our birth and behaviour.

sa: भवतां हि कृतास्त्रत्वं यथाऽऽदित्ये प्रभा तथा। यथा चन्द्रमसो लक्ष्मीः सर्वथा नापकृष्यते॥ एवं भवत्सु ब्राह्मण्यं ब्रह्मास्त्रं च प्रतिष्ठितम्। चत्वार एकतो वेदाः क्षात्रमेकत्र दृश्यते॥
en: The mastery of weapons is in you as the rays are in the sun. As Lakshmi is never separated from the moon, so the Vedas and the Brahma weapons are always established in you. It is seen that the four Vedas exist in one place and all the attributes of a Kshatriya exist in another place.

sa: त्वत्प्रपन्नाय भक्ताय शिरसा प्रणताय च। ध्यानस्यास्य यथा तत्त्वं ब्रूहि धर्मभृतां वर॥
en: O foremost of pious men, tell me the cause of this abstraction. I solicit your favour, and am your devoted worshipper, and am bending my head to you.

sa: सोऽच्छिनत् कस्याचित् पादौ जघनं चैव कस्यचित्। कांश्चिद बिभेद पार्श्वेषु कालसृष्ट इवान्तकः॥
en: Ashvatthaman cut of the legs of some, and the hips of others, and cut some in their back, moving about like the Destroyer himself let loose by Time.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच व्यथयेयुरिमे सेनां देवानामपि संजय। आहवे ये न्यवर्तन्त वृकोदरमुखा नृपाः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, those heroic sovereigns who now returned to the charge, being headed by Vrikodara, were capable of crushing even the host of the celestials themselves.
